units.zh: 天福元年十一月己亥，帝御北京崇元殿，降制：「改長興七年為天福元年，大赦天下。
units.en: On the jihai day of the eleventh month of Tianfu 1, the emperor entered the Chongyuan Hall at the Northern Capital and promulgated an edict: "The seventh year of Changxing is hereby renamed Tianfu 1, and a general amnesty is proclaimed for all under Heaven.
units.literal: On the jihai day of the eleventh month of the first year of Tianfu, the Emperor took the throne in the Chongyuan Hall at the Northern Capital and issued an edict: "Let the seventh year of Changxing be changed to the first year of Tianfu, and grant a general amnesty throughout the realm.

units.zh: 十一月九日昧爽已前，應在京及諸州諸色罪犯，及曾授偽命職掌官吏，並見禁囚徒，已結正未結正，已發覺未發覺，罪無輕重，常赦不原者，咸赦除之。
units.en: Before dawn on the ninth day of the eleventh month, every class of offender in the capital and in the provinces, every official who had once held office under the usurper regime, and every prisoner still in custody—case closed or pending, offense known or not, grave or slight, including crimes ordinarily beyond the reach of amnesty—was pardoned and set free.
units.literal: Before dawn on the ninth day of the eleventh month, all offenders of every category in the capital and the various prefectures, officials who had once received appointments from the false regime, and prisoners currently held in custody—whether their cases had been concluded or not, whether discovered or not, regardless of the severity of the offense, and even those normally excluded from routine amnesties—were all pardoned and released.

units.zh: 應明宗朝所行敕命法制，仰所在遵行，不得改易。
units.en: The edicts and statutes issued in the Tang reign of Emperor Mingzong are to be observed everywhere as written, without change.
units.literal: As for the edicts and regulations promulgated in the reign of Emperor Mingzong of Tang, [authorities] in each locality are to follow them and may not alter them.

units.zh: 其在京鹽貨，元是官場出糴，自今後並不禁斷，一任人戶取便糴易，仍下太原府，更不得開場糴貨。
units.en: Salt in the capital had formerly been sold only through government markets; hereafter the trade is not to be restricted, and households may buy and sell freely. Taiyuan Prefecture was likewise ordered to cease operating state salt-purchase depots.
units.literal: Salt goods in the capital had originally been purchased from government depots; from now on this monopoly is not to be enforced, and households may buy and sell as they please; an order was also sent to Taiyuan Prefecture that it must no longer operate purchasing depots for salt.

units.zh: 其曲每斤與減價錢三十文。」
units.en: The price of distilled liquor was cut by thirty cash per jin."
units.literal: For liquor, the price per jin was to be reduced by thirty cash."

units.zh: 以節度判官趙瑩為翰林學士承旨、守尚書戶部侍郎、知河東軍府事，以節度掌書記桑維翰為翰林學士、守尚書禮部侍郎、知樞密院事，以觀察判官薛融為吏部郎中兼侍御史、知雜事，太原縣令羅周嶽為左諫議大夫，節度推官竇貞固為翰林學士，軍城都巡檢使劉知遠為侍衛馬軍都指揮使，客將景延廣為步軍都指揮使，太原少尹李玘為尚書工部侍郎。
units.en: Zhao Ying, judge of the military administration, was appointed Grand Academician and Drafter of the Hanlin Academy, acting Minister of Revenue, with charge of Hedong military prefecture affairs; Sang Weihan, military secretary, became Hanlin Academician, acting Minister of Rites, and Controller of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Xue Rong, observation judge, became Director in the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent Remonstrance Censor and supervising censor; Luo Zhouyue, magistrate of Taiyuan County, became Left Remonstrance Censor; Dou Zhengu, military evaluator, became Hanlin Academician; Liu Zhiyuan, chief metropolitan garrison inspector, became Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry; Jing Yanguang, guest officer, became Commander of the Palace Guard Infantry; and Li Qi, vice magistrate of Taiyuan, became Vice Minister of Works.
units.literal: Zhao Ying, military administration judge, was made Grand Academician and Drafter of the Hanlin Academy, acting Minister of Revenue, and in charge of Hedong military prefecture affairs; Sang Weihan, military administration secretary, was made Hanlin Academician, acting Minister of Rites, and Controller of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Xue Rong, observation administration judge, was made Director in the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent Remonstrance Censor and chief supervising censor; Luo Zhouyue, magistrate of Taiyuan County, was made Left Remonstrance Censor; Dou Zhengu, military administration evaluator, was made Hanlin Academician; Liu Zhiyuan, metropolitan garrison chief inspector, was made Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry; Jing Yanguang, guest officer, was made Commander of the Palace Guard Infantry; Li Qi, vice magistrate of Taiyuan, was made Vice Minister of Works.

units.zh: 閏十一月甲子，晉安寨副招討使楊光遠等殺上將張敬達，以諸軍來降。
units.en: On jiazi in the intercalary eleventh month, Yang Guangyuan, deputy pacification commissioner at Jin'an Stockade, and his associates killed the supreme commander Zhang Jingda and surrendered the entire force.
units.literal: On the jiazi day of the intercalary eleventh month, Yang Guangyuan, deputy pacification commissioner of Jin'an Stockade, and others killed the supreme commander Zhang Jingda and brought all the armies to surrender.

units.zh: 丙寅，制以翰林學士承旨、知河東軍府、戶部侍郎、知制誥趙瑩為門下侍郎同中書門下平章事，監修國史。
units.en: On bingyin, Zhao Ying—Grand Academician and Drafter, overseer of Hedong military prefecture, Vice Minister of Revenue, and drafter of rescripts—was made Vice Minister of State Affairs and Grand Councilor, with charge of compiling the national history.
units.literal: On the bingyin day, an edict appointed Zhao Ying, Grand Academician and Drafter of the Hanlin Academy, in charge of Hedong military prefecture, Vice Minister of Revenue, and drafter of imperial rescripts, as Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent Grand Councilor, and Supervisor of the National History.

units.zh: 以翰林學士、權知樞密事、禮部侍郎、知制誥桑維翰為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，依前知樞密院事，並賜推忠興運致理功臣。
units.en: Sang Weihan, Hanlin Academician, acting military affairs controller, Vice Minister of Rites, and rescript drafter, became Vice Minister of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies, retaining control of military affairs, and was granted the honorific Meritorious Minister for Promoting Loyalty, Raising Fortune, and Achieving Order.
units.literal: Sang Weihan, Hanlin Academician, acting Controller of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Minister of Rites, and drafter of imperial rescripts, was made Vice Minister of the Chancellery with concurrent Grand Councilor and Grand Academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies, and continued as before in charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs; he was also granted the title of Meritorious Minister for Promoting Loyalty, Raising Fortune, and Achieving Order.

units.zh: 甲戌，車駕至昭義，受趙德鈞、延壽降。
units.en: On jiaxu the emperor reached Zhaoyi and accepted the surrender of Zhao Dejun and his son Yanshou.
units.literal: On the jiaxu day, the imperial carriage reached Zhaoyi and received the surrender of Zhao Dejun and Yanshou.

units.zh: 是日，戎王舉酒謂帝曰：「予遠來赴義，大事已成。
units.en: That day the Khitan ruler raised his cup and told the emperor, "I came from far away to answer your call, and the great enterprise is won.
units.literal: That day the Rong King raised his cup and said to the Emperor: "I came from afar to join this righteous cause, and the great affair is already accomplished.

units.zh: 皇帝須赴京都，今令大詳袞勒兵相送至河梁。
units.en: Your Majesty must go on to the capital; I have ordered Dayxiangun to escort you with his troops as far as the river crossing.
units.literal: The Emperor must proceed to the capital; I now order Dayxiangun to lead troops to escort you as far as the Yellow River crossing.

units.zh: 要過河者，任意多少。
units.en: Take as many men across the river as you need.
units.literal: Those who wish to cross the river may do so in whatever numbers they choose.

units.zh: 予亦且在此州，俟京、洛京平定，便當北轅。」
units.en: I too shall remain in this prefecture for the time being; once the capitals of Chang'an and Luoyang are pacified, I shall turn my carriage north."
units.literal: I too shall remain in this prefecture for the time being; once the capitals of Chang'an and Luoyang are pacified, I shall turn my carriage north."

units.zh: 執手相泣，久不能別。
units.en: They clasped hands and wept, and for a long time could not bring themselves to part.
units.literal: They clasped hands and wept together, unable to part for a long while.

units.zh: 脫白貂裘以衣帝，贈細馬二十匹，戰馬一千二百匹，仍誡曰：「子子孫孫，各無相忘。」
units.en: He removed his white sable coat and put it on the Emperor, presented twenty fine horses and twelve hundred war horses, and admonished him, saying: "Sons and grandsons alike—let none forget the other."
units.literal: He removed his white sable coat and put it on the Emperor, presented twenty fine horses and twelve hundred war horses, and admonished him, saying: "Sons and grandsons alike—let none forget the other."

units.zh: 己卯，至河陽北，節度使萇從簡來降，舟楫已具。
units.en: On jimao he reached the north bank at Heyang; Military Commissioner Chang Congjian surrendered, and boats were ready.
units.literal: On the jimao day, [the Emperor] reached the north bank of Heyang; Military Commissioner Chang Congjian came to surrender, and boats were already prepared.

units.zh: 庚辰，望見洛陽煙火相次，有將校飛狀請進。
units.en: On gengchen they sighted the smoke and fires of Luoyang in succession, and officers sent urgent petitions asking to press forward.
units.literal: On the gengchen day, smoke and fires of Luoyang came into view one after another; officers sent urgent memorials requesting to advance.

units.zh: 辛巳，唐末帝聚其族，與親將宋審虔等登元武樓，縱火自焚而死。
units.en: On xinsi the last Tang emperor gathered his kin, and with his trusted general Song Shenqian and others climbed the Yuanwu Tower, set it afire, and perished in the flames.
units.literal: On the xinsi day, the Last Emperor of Tang gathered his clan, and with his intimate general Song Shenqian and others ascended the Yuanwu Tower, set fire, and burned himself to death.

units.zh: 至晚，車駕入洛。
units.en: By nightfall the imperial procession entered Luoyang.
units.literal: By evening the imperial carriage entered Luoyang.

units.zh: 唐兵解甲待罪，皆慰而舍之。
units.en: Tang troops laid down their arms to await judgment; the emperor reassured them and let them go.
units.literal: Tang soldiers laid down their armor and awaited punishment; all were comforted and released.

units.zh: 帝止潛龍舊第，百官稍稍見焉。
units.en: The emperor lodged at his old Hidden Dragon residence, and officials began to present themselves in small numbers.
units.literal: The Emperor stayed at his former Hidden Dragon residence, and officials gradually came to see him.

units.zh: 詔御史府促朝官入見，詔文武兩班臣僚應事偽庭者並釋罪。
units.en: He ordered the Censorate to summon court officials for audience and proclaimed that every civil and military officer who had served the usurper regime was absolved of guilt.
units.literal: An edict ordered the Censorate to urge court officials to come for audience; an edict declared that civil and military officials of both ranks who had served the false court were all pardoned.

units.zh: 是日，百辟謝恩於宮門之外。
units.en: That day the officials offered thanks for the amnesty outside the palace gates.
units.literal: That day the hundred officials gave thanks for grace outside the palace gates.

units.zh: 甲申，車駕入內，禦文明殿受朝賀，用唐禮樂。
units.en: On jiashen the emperor entered the palace, took the throne in the Hall of Civil Splendor to receive congratulations, and used Tang court music.
units.literal: On the jiashen day, the imperial carriage entered the inner palace; [the Emperor] took the throne in the Hall of Civil Splendor to receive congratulatory homage, using Tang ritual music.

units.zh: 制：「大赦天下，應中外諸色職掌官吏內曾有受偽命者，一切不問。
units.en: An edict stated: "Grant a general amnesty throughout the realm; among officials of every rank at home and abroad who had once received appointments from the false regime, none shall be questioned.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Grant a general amnesty throughout the realm; among officials of every rank at home and abroad who had once received appointments from the false regime, none shall be questioned.

units.zh: 偽廷賊臣張延朗、劉延皓、劉延朗等，並奸邪害物，貪猥弄權，罪既滿盈，理難容貸。
units.en: The usurper's ministers Zhang Yanlang, Liu Yanhao, Liu Yanlang, and the rest were wicked, greedy, and abusive of power; their crimes were beyond pardon.
units.literal: The traitorous ministers of the false court—Zhang Yanlang, Liu Yanhao, Liu Yanlang, and others—were all wicked and harmful, greedy and corrupt in wielding power; their offenses were full to overflowing, and reason could not permit leniency.

units.zh: 除此三人已行敕命指揮外，其有宰臣馬裔孫、樞密使房暠、宣徽使李專美、河府節度使韓昭裔等四人，並令釋放。
units.en: Those three aside, for whom orders of execution had already gone out, four others—Chief Councilor Ma Yisun, Military Affairs Commissioner Fang Hao, Palace Attendant Li Zhuanmei, and Heyang Military Commissioner Han Zhaoyi—were ordered released.
units.literal: Apart from these three, for whom edicts had already been issued, the four men—Chief Councilor Ma Yisun, Military Affairs Commissioner Fang Hao, Palace Attendant Li Zhuanmei, and Heyang Military Commissioner Han Zhaoyi—were all ordered released.

units.zh: 少帝宜令中書門下追尊定謚，擇日禮葬；
units.en: The Young Emperor was to receive posthumous honors and a fixed temple name from the Chancellery, with state burial on a chosen day;
units.literal: The Young Emperor should have the Chancellery posthumously honor him and fix his posthumous title, and bury him with full rites on a chosen day;

units.zh: 妃孔氏，宜行追冊祔葬。
units.en: and his consort, Lady Kong, was to be posthumously enfeoffed and interred beside him.
units.literal: his consort Lady Kong was to receive posthumous enfeoffment and be buried beside him.

units.zh: 應天下節度使、刺史下賓席郡職及將校等，委中書門下各與改轉官資。
units.en: Every military commissioner, prefect, county official, and officer in the realm was to have rank adjusted through the Chancellery.
units.literal: All military commissioners, prefects, subordinate county officials of guest rank, and officers throughout the realm were entrusted to the Chancellery to have their official ranks adjusted in each case.

units.zh: 其北京管內鹽鐺戶，合納逐年鹽利，昨者偽命指揮，每鬥須令人戶折納白米一斗五升，極知百姓艱苦。
units.en: Salt-pan households in the Northern Capital circuit owed annual salt levies; the usurper had required one dou and five sheng of rice per dou of salt—a burden the court well knew the people could scarcely bear.
units.literal: Salt-pan households within the Northern Capital circuit owed annual salt levies; under the false regime's orders each dou had required households to pay one dou and five sheng of white rice in commutation—it was fully understood how hard this was on the people.

units.zh: 自今後宜令人戶以元納食鹽石鬥數目，每鬥依實價計定錢數，取人戶便穩，折納斛斗。
units.en: Henceforth households were to pay against their original salt quotas, with each dou commuted to cash at fair market rates or, as suited each household, to grain.
units.literal: From now on households should pay according to the original salt quota in shi and dou; for each dou the cash amount was to be fixed according to the true price, taking whatever was convenient for the household in commutation of grain.

units.zh: 其洛京管內逐年所配人戶食鹽，起來年每斤特與減價錢十文。
units.en: For the Luoyang circuit's annual household salt allotments, the price per jin was cut by ten cash beginning the following year.
units.literal: For household salt allotments within the Luoyang circuit each year, starting next year the price per jin was specially to be reduced by ten cash.

units.zh: 應諸道商稅，仰逐處將省司合收稅條例，榜於本院前。
units.en: Each circuit was to post the central ministries' combined commercial tax schedules before its own offices.
units.literal: For commercial taxes in all circuits, each locality was to post the combined tax regulations of the central ministries before its own office.

units.zh: 榜內該設名目者，即得收稅。」
units.en: Tax was to be collected only for items named on the posted list."
units.literal: Only items listed on the placard were permitted to be taxed."

units.zh: 十二月乙酉朔，幸河陽，餞送大詳袞、蕃部兵士歸國，詔降末帝為庶人。
units.en: On the first day of the twelfth month he went to Heyang to bid farewell to Dayxiangun and the tribal troops returning home, and degraded the last Tang emperor to commoner rank.
units.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, yiyou, [the Emperor] visited Heyang to give a farewell feast for Dayxiangun and the tribal troops returning to their country; an edict degraded the Last Emperor to commoner status.

units.zh: 丁亥，制以司空馮道守本官兼門下侍郎、平章事、宏文館大學士，以步軍都指揮使符彥饒為滑州節度使，以河陽節度使萇從簡為許州節度使，以澤州刺史劉凝為華州節度使，以皇子重乂為河南尹。
units.en: On dinghai, Feng Dao retained his rank as Sikong and added Vice Minister of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall; Fu Yanrao became Military Commissioner of Hua Prefecture (Huazhou, Henan); Chang Congjian of Heyang became Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture; Liu Ning, prefect of Zezhou, became Military Commissioner of Hua Prefecture (Huazhou, Shaanxi); and Imperial Prince Chongyi became Intendant of Henan.
units.literal: On the dinghai day, an edict appointed Sikong Feng Dao to retain his original office with concurrent Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall; Fu Yanrao, Commander of the Palace Guard Infantry, as Military Commissioner of Huazhou; Chang Congjian, Military Commissioner of Heyang, as Military Commissioner of Xuzhou; Liu Ning, Prefect of Zezhou, as Military Commissioner of Huazhou; and the imperial prince Chongyi as Intendant of Henan.

units.zh: 庚寅，以滑州節度判官石光贊為宗正卿。
units.en: On gengyin, Shi Guangzan, judge of the Huazhou military administration, became Director of the Imperial Clan.
units.literal: On the gengyin day, Shi Guangzan, military administration judge of Huazhou, was made Director of the Imperial Clan.

units.zh: 辛卯，以舊相姚顗為刑部尚書。
units.en: On xinmao the former chief councilor Yao Hao was appointed Minister of Justice.
units.literal: On the xinmao day, the former chief councilor Yao Hao was made Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 時自秋不雨，經冬無雪，命群官遍加祈禱。
units.en: Rain had failed since autumn and snow through winter; the emperor ordered officials throughout the realm to pray.
units.literal: At this time there had been no rain since autumn and no snow through winter; the Emperor ordered officials everywhere to offer prayers.

units.zh: 癸巳，以邠州節度使張希崇為靈武節度使，鄧州節度使皇甫遇為定州節度使。
units.en: On guisi, Zhang Xichong of Binzhou became Military Commissioner of Lingwu, and Huangfu Yu of Dengzhou became Military Commissioner of Dingzhou.
units.literal: On the guisi day, Zhang Xichong, Military Commissioner of Binzhou, was made Military Commissioner of Lingwu; Huangfu Yu, Military Commissioner of Dengzhou, was made Military Commissioner of Dingzhou.

units.zh: 詔國朝文物制度、起居入閣，宜依唐明宗朝事例施行。
units.en: He ordered that court ritual and the practice of entering the hall for daily audience follow Tang precedents from the reign of Emperor Mingzong.
units.literal: An edict stated that the dynasty's ritual institutions and the practice of entering the hall for daily audience should follow the precedents of the Tang reign of Emperor Mingzong.

units.zh: 鎮州衙內都虞候秘瓊作亂，逐副使李彥琦，殺都指揮使胡章。
units.en: Mi Qiong, chief adjutant at the Zhenzhou headquarters, mutinied, expelled Vice Commissioner Li Yanqi, and killed Commander Hu Zhang.
units.literal: Mi Qiong, chief garrison adjutant within the Zhenzhou headquarters, rebelled, drove out Vice Commissioner Li Yanqi, and killed Commander Hu Zhang.

units.zh: 同州小校門鐸殺節度使楊漢賓，燒劫州城。
units.en: Men Duo, a junior officer at Tongzhou, killed Military Commissioner Yang Hanbin and burned and looted the prefectural seat.
units.literal: Men Duo, a junior officer of Tongzhou, killed Military Commissioner Yang Hanbin and burned and plundered the prefectural city.

units.zh: 丙申，帝為明宗皇后曹氏薨舉哀於長春殿，輟朝三日。
units.en: On bingshen the emperor mourned the death of Empress Cao, consort of Tang Emperor Mingzong, in the Everlasting Spring Hall and suspended court for three days.
units.literal: On the bingshen day, the Emperor mourned the death of Empress Cao, consort of Emperor Mingzong, in the Everlasting Spring Hall and suspended court for three days.

units.zh: 詔封故東丹王李贊華為燕王，遣前單州刺史李肅部署歸葬本國。
units.en: The late King of Dongdan, Li Zanhua, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yan, and former Danzhou Prefect Li Su was sent to arrange his return and burial in his homeland.
units.literal: An edict enfeoffed the late King of Dongdan, Li Zanhua, as Prince of Yan and sent the former Prefect of Danzhou, Li Su, to arrange his return and burial in his native land.

units.zh: 以右拾遺吳涓為左補闕，充樞密院學士。
units.en: Wu Juan, Right Remembrancer, became Left Supplementation Censor and Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: Wu Juan, Right Remembrancer, was made Left Supplementation Censor and appointed Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 己亥，以汴州節度使李周充西京留守，以前河中節度使李從璋為鄧州節度使。
units.en: On jihai, Li Zhou of Bianzhou became Western Capital Regent, and Li Congzhang, former Military Commissioner of Hezhong, became Military Commissioner of Dengzhou.
units.literal: On the jihai day, Li Zhou, Military Commissioner of Bianzhou, was made Western Capital Regent; Li Congzhang, former Military Commissioner of Hezhong, was made Military Commissioner of Dengzhou.

units.zh: 茲州奏，草寇攻城，三日而退。
units.en: Cizhou reported that bandits besieged the city and withdrew after three days.
units.literal: Cizhou reported that bandits attacked the city and withdrew after three days.

units.zh: 庚子，帝為皇弟故彰聖指揮使敬殷、沂州指揮使敬德、檢校太子賓客敬友舉哀於長春殿。
units.en: On gengzi the emperor mourned in the Everlasting Spring Hall for his younger brothers—the late Commander of Zhangsheng, Jing Yin; Commander of Yizhou, Jing De; and Acting Guest of the Heir Apparent, Jing You.
units.literal: On the gengzi day, the Emperor mourned in the Everlasting Spring Hall for his imperial younger brothers—the late Commander of Zhangsheng, Jing Yin; Commander of Yizhou, Jing De; and Acting Guest of the Heir Apparent, Jing You.

units.zh: 以舊相盧文紀為吏部尚書；
units.en: The former chief councilor Lu Wenji was made Minister of Personnel;
units.literal: The former chief councilor Lu Wenji was made Minister of Personnel;

units.zh: 以皇城使周環為大將軍，充三司使；
units.en: Palace Commissioner Zhou Huan was made Grand General and Commissioner of the Three Agencies;
units.literal: Palace Commissioner Zhou Huan was made Grand General and appointed Commissioner of the Three Agencies;

units.zh: 以左贊善大夫馬重績為司天監。
units.en: and Ma Chongji, Left Mentor of the Heir Apparent, became Director of the Astronomical Bureau.
units.literal: Ma Chongji, Left Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Director of the Astronomical Bureau.

units.zh: 青州奏，節度使房知溫卒，詔鄆州王建立以所部牙兵往青州安撫。
units.en: Qingzhou reported the death of Military Commissioner Fang Zhiwen; Wang Jianli of Yanzhou was ordered to take his guard troops to Qingzhou to restore order.
units.literal: Qingzhou reported that Military Commissioner Fang Zhiwen had died; an edict ordered Wang Jianli of Yanzhou to take his headquarters guard troops to Qingzhou to pacify the region.

units.zh: 中書門下奏：「請以來年二月二十八日帝慶誕日為天和節。」
units.en: The Chancellery memorialized: "We request that the twenty-eighth day of the second month of next year, the Emperor's birthday, be established as the Tianhe Festival."
units.literal: The Chancellery memorialized: "We request that the twenty-eighth day of the second month of next year, the Emperor's birthday, be established as the Tianhe Festival."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: [The request] was approved.

units.zh: 天福二年春正月甲寅朔，帝御文明殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
units.en: On New Year's Day of Tianfu 2, the emperor received New Year congratulations in the Hall of Civil Splendor with full ceremonial guard.
units.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring in the second year of Tianfu, jiayin, the Emperor took the throne in the Hall of Civil Splendor to receive congratulatory homage, with guards and insignia in full form.

units.zh: 乙卯，日有蝕之。
units.en: On yimao there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: On the yimao day there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 是夜，有赤白氣相間，如耕墾竹林之狀。
units.en: That night alternating red and white vapors appeared, shaped like furrowed fields and bamboo stands.
units.literal: That night red and white vapors alternated, shaped like plowed fields and bamboo groves.

units.zh: 自亥至醜，生北濁，過中天，明滅不定，遍二十八宿，徹曙方散。
units.en: From hai through chou they rose murkily in the north, crossed the zenith flickering unpredictably, spanned all twenty-eight mansions, and did not disperse until dawn.
units.literal: From the hai hour to the chou hour they arose in the north in murky form, passed the zenith, brightening and dimming without fixed pattern, spanning all twenty-eight lunar mansions, and only dispersed at dawn.

units.zh: 丁巳，故皇弟敬德、敬殷並贈太傅，皇子重乂、重進、重英並贈太保。
units.en: On dingsi the late imperial brothers Jing De and Jing Yin were posthumously made Grand Preceptor, and Princes Chongyi, Chongjin, and Chongying were posthumously made Grand Guardian.
units.literal: On the dingsi day, the late imperial younger brothers Jing De and Jing Yin were both posthumously made Grand Preceptor; the imperial princes Chongyi, Chongjin, and Chongying were all posthumously made Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 右神武統軍康思立卒，輟視朝，贈太子少師。
units.en: Kang Sili, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, died; the emperor suspended audience and posthumously made him Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: Kang Sili, Commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, died; court audience was suspended; he was posthumously made Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 是日，詔曰：「唐莊宗陵名與國諱同，宜改為伊陵。
units.en: That day an edict stated: "The tomb name of Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong is identical to the dynastic taboo and should be changed to Yiling.
units.literal: That day an edict stated: "The tomb name of Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong is identical to the dynastic taboo and should be changed to Yiling.

units.zh: 應京畿及諸州縣，舊有唐朝諸帝陵，並真源等縣，並不為次赤，卻以畿甸緊望為定。
units.en: In the capital region and in counties such as Zhenyuan that housed Tang imperial tombs, county rank was no longer to be lowered to secondary red but was to follow metropolitan standards for tight and eminent districts.
units.literal: In the capital region and all prefectures and counties where Tang imperial tombs stood, including Zhenyuan and similar counties, they were no longer to be ranked as secondary red [counties] but were to be fixed according to the tight and eminent standards of the metropolitan circuit.

units.zh: 其逐處縣令，不得以陵臺結銜。
units.en: Magistrates were forbidden to add tomb-guard titles to their official designations.
units.literal: Magistrates in each place might not attach tomb-platform titles to their official designations.

units.zh: 考滿日，依出選門官例指揮，隔任後準格例施行。
units.en: On completion of their terms they were to be treated like officials leaving the selection gate, with standard regulations applying after one intervening appointment.
units.literal: When their terms of evaluation were complete, they were to be directed according to the precedent for officials exiting the selection gate; after one intervening appointment the standard regulations were to apply.

units.zh: 其宋州、亳州節度使、刺史，落太清宮使副名額。」
units.en: The military commissioners and prefects of Songzhou and Bozhou were to drop the supplementary title of Deputy Commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace."
units.literal: The military commissioners and prefects of Songzhou and Bozhou were to drop the supplementary title of Deputy Commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace."

units.zh: 庚申，以前吏部郎中兼侍御史、知雜事王松為左諫議大夫，水部郎中王易簡本官知制誥。
units.en: On gengshen, Wang Song, former Director in the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent supervising censor, became Left Remonstrance Censor, and Wang Yijian, Director in the Ministry of Works, was made drafter of rescripts in addition to his post.
units.literal: On the gengshen day, Wang Song, former Director in the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent Remonstrance Censor and chief supervising censor, was made Left Remonstrance Censor; Wang Yijian, Director in the Ministry of Works, retained his office and was made drafter of imperial rescripts.

units.zh: 定州奏，契丹改幽州為南京。
units.en: Dingzhou reported that the Khitan had renamed Youzhou the Southern Capital.
units.literal: Dingzhou reported that the Khitan had renamed Youzhou as the Southern Capital.

units.zh: 中書奏，請立宗廟，從之。
units.en: The Chancellery proposed establishing the ancestral temple, and the proposal was approved.
units.literal: The Chancellery memorialized requesting establishment of the ancestral temple; [the request] was approved.

units.zh: 以翰林學士、工部侍郎和凝為禮部侍郎，依前充職。
units.en: He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Works, became Vice Minister of Rites while retaining his other duties.
units.literal: He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Rites and continued in his former duties.

units.zh: 詔內外文武臣僚並與加恩，皇基初造，示普恩也。
units.en: Civil and military officials at home and abroad were granted favors—a general grace to mark the founding of the new dynasty.
units.literal: An edict granted favors to civil and military officials at home and abroad alike—the dynasty's foundation was newly laid, and this displayed universal grace.

units.zh: 太子少保致仕華溫琪卒，贈太子太保。
units.en: Hua Wenqi, retired Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, died and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: Hua Wenqi, retired Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, died and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 是日，詔：「應朝臣中有藉才特除外任者，秩滿無遺闕，將來擬官之時，在外一任同在朝一任升進。
units.en: That day an edict stated: "Among court officials who were specially sent to external posts on account of talent, when their terms are completed without omission or fault, at the time of future appointment one term outside the court shall count the same as one term at court for advancement.
units.literal: That day an edict stated: "Among court officials who were specially sent to external posts on account of talent, when their terms are completed without omission or fault, at the time of future appointment one term outside the court shall count the same as one term at court for advancement.

units.zh: 其就便自求外職及不是特達選任者，不在此限。」
units.en: Those who sought external posts for their own convenience and those not chosen through special direct selection are not within this scope."
units.literal: Those who sought external posts for their own convenience and those not chosen through special direct selection are not within this scope."

units.zh: 安州上言，節度使盧文進殺行軍副使，率部下親兵過淮。
units.en: Anzhou reported that Military Commissioner Lu Wenjin had killed his campaigning vice commissioner and led his personal guard across the Huai River.
units.literal: Anzhou reported that Military Commissioner Lu Wenjin had killed the campaigning vice commissioner and led his personal guard troops across the Huai.

units.zh: 以前天平軍節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中王建立為平盧軍節度使，以守司空門下侍郎、平章事、宏文館大學士馮道兼諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。
units.en: Wang Jianli, former Military Commissioner of Tianping with acting Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant, became Military Commissioner of Pinglu; Feng Dao, acting Sikong, Vice Minister of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall, was also made Commissioner of Salt, Iron, and Transport for all circuits.
units.literal: Wang Jianli, former Military Commissioner of Tianping Army, Acting Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Attendant, was made Military Commissioner of Pinglu Army; Feng Dao, acting Sikong, Vice Minister of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall, was made concurrent Commissioner of Salt, Iron, and Transport for all circuits.

units.zh: 天雄軍節度使、兼中書令範延光改封秦國公，加食邑實封；
units.en: Fan Yanguang, Military Commissioner of Tianxiong and concurrent Palace Secretariat Director, was re-enfeoffed Duke of Qin with increased fief income and actual enfeoffment;
units.literal: Fan Yanguang, Military Commissioner of Tianxiong Army and concurrent Palace Secretariat Director, was re-enfeoffed as Duke of Qin with increased fief income and actual enfeoffment;

units.zh: 鳳翔節度使、兼中書令、西平王李從嚴加食邑實封。
units.en: Li Congyan, Military Commissioner of Fengxiang, Palace Secretariat Director, and Prince of Xiping, received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment.
units.literal: Li Congyan, Military Commissioner of Fengxiang, concurrent Palace Secretariat Director, and Prince of Xiping, received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment.

units.zh: 乙丑，以端明殿學士、禮部侍郎呂琦為檢校工部尚書、秘書監。
units.en: On yichou, Lü Qi, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination and Vice Minister of Rites, became Acting Minister of Works and Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the yichou day, Lü Qi, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination and Vice Minister of Rites, was made Acting Minister of Works and Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 丙寅，改中興殿為天福殿，門名從之。
units.en: On bingyin the Hall of Central Revival was renamed the Hall of Heavenly Blessing, and the gate names were changed accordingly.
units.literal: On the bingyin day, the Hall of Central Revival was renamed the Hall of Heavenly Blessing, and the gate names followed suit.

units.zh: 湖南節度使、楚王馬希範加食邑實封，改賜功臣名號。
units.en: Ma Xifan, Military Commissioner of Hunan and King of Chu, received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment and a new honorific title.
units.literal: Ma Xifan, Military Commissioner of Hunan and King of Chu, received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment, and was granted a new honorific title of meritorious minister.

units.zh: 前昭義節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事高行周起復右金吾衛大將軍，依前昭義軍節度使。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou, former Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi with acting Grand Mentor and Associate Grand Councilor, was recalled as Grand General of the Right Golden Crow Guard and resumed as Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi.
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou, former Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, Acting Grand Mentor, and Associate Grand Councilor, was recalled to service as Grand General of the Right Golden Crow Guard and continued as before as Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi Army.

units.zh: 泰寧軍節度使李從溫、荊南節度使南平王高從誨、歸德軍節度使趙在禮，並加食邑實封，改功臣名號。
units.en: Li Congwen of Taining, Gao Conghui of Jingnan and Prince of Nanping, and Zhao Zaili of Guide all received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment and new honorific titles.
units.literal: Li Congwen, Military Commissioner of Taining Army; Gao Conghui, Military Commissioner of Jingnan and Prince of Nanping; and Zhao Zaili, Military Commissioner of Guide Army—all received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment and had their honorific titles of meritorious minister changed.

units.zh: 以端明殿學士、戶部侍郎李崧為兵部侍郎、判戶部，以左諫議大夫王松判度支。
units.en: Li Song, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination and Vice Minister of Revenue, became Vice Minister of War with charge of the Ministry of Revenue, and Wang Song, Left Remonstrance Censor, was given charge of the Bureau of Budget.
units.literal: Li Song, Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War and given charge of the Ministry of Revenue; Wang Song, Left Remonstrance Censor, was given charge of the Bureau of Budget.

units.zh: 魏府範延光奏：「當管夏津鎮捕賊兵士，誤殺卻新齊州防禦使秘瓊。」
units.en: Fan Yanguang of Weifu memorialized: "Soldiers of Xiajin Town in this jurisdiction who were pursuing bandits mistakenly killed Mi Qiong, the newly appointed Defender of Qizhou."
units.literal: Fan Yanguang of Weifu memorialized: "Soldiers of Xiajin Town in this jurisdiction who were pursuing bandits mistakenly killed Mi Qiong, the newly appointed Defender of Qizhou."

units.zh: 初，延光將萌異志，使人潛結於瓊，諾之。
units.en: Earlier, as Yanguang was plotting rebellion, he had sent agents to win Qiong's secret agreement, which Qiong gave.
units.literal: Earlier, when Yanguang was about to harbor rebellious intent, he had sent men to secretly contact Qiong, who agreed.

units.zh: 及是，以瓊背其謀，密使精騎殺之，由是延光反狀明矣。
units.en: Now, believing Qiong had betrayed him, he secretly sent picked cavalry to kill him, and his rebellion became unmistakable.
units.literal: At this time, because Qiong had betrayed his plot, he secretly sent elite cavalry to kill him; thus Yanguang's rebellious designs became clear.

units.zh: 以工部侍郎李玘檢校右僕射，為汾州刺史，以前彰國軍節度使尹暉為左千牛衛上將軍。
units.en: Li Qi, Vice Minister of Works, became Acting Vice Director of the Right Secretariat and Prefect of Fenzhou; Yin Hui, former Military Commissioner of Zhangguo, became Senior General of the Left Office of the Imperial Stud.
units.literal: Li Qi, Vice Minister of Works, was made Acting Vice Director of the Right Secretariat and Prefect of Fenzhou; Yin Hui, former Military Commissioner of Zhangguo Army, was made Senior General of the Left Office of the Imperial Stud.

units.zh: 是日，詔曰：「西天中印土摩竭陀舍衛國大菩提寺三藏阿阇梨沙門室利縛羅，宜賜號宏梵大師。」
units.en: That day an edict stated: "The Tripitaka Master and Acarya monk Shilipoluo of the Great Bodhi Monastery in Kapilavastu, Magadha, in central India of the Western Heaven, should be granted the title Great Master of Vast Brahma."
units.literal: That day an edict stated: "The Tripitaka Master and Acarya monk Shilipoluo of the Great Bodhi Monastery in Kapilavastu, Magadha, in central India of the Western Heaven, should be granted the title Great Master of Vast Brahma."

units.zh: 庚午，涇州節度使李德充、徐州節度使安彥威、秦州節度使康福、延州節度使劉景巖、襄州節度使安從進、夏州節度使李彜殷，並加食邑實封。
units.en: On gengwu, Military Commissioners Li Dechong of Jingzhou, An Yanwei of Xuzhou, Kang Fu of Qinzhou, Liu Jingyan of Yanzhou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou, and Li Yiyin of Xiazhou all received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment.
units.literal: On the gengwu day, Li Dechong, Military Commissioner of Jingzhou; An Yanwei, Military Commissioner of Xuzhou; Kang Fu, Military Commissioner of Qinzhou; Liu Jingyan, Military Commissioner of Yanzhou; An Congjin, Military Commissioner of Xiangzhou; and Li Yiyin, Military Commissioner of Xiazhou—all received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment.

units.zh: 壬申，正衙備禮冊贈故皇弟、皇子等。
units.en: On renshen the main court held full rites to posthumously enfeoff the late imperial brothers and princes.
units.literal: On the renshen day, full rites were prepared at the main court to enfeoff posthumously the late imperial younger brothers, imperial princes, and others.

units.zh: 丙子，故契丹人皇王歸葬，輟視朝一日。
units.en: On bingzi the late Khitan Renhuang King was sent home for burial, and court audience was suspended for one day.
units.literal: On the bingzi day, the late Khitan Renhuang King was returned for burial; court audience was suspended for one day.

units.zh: 改汴州雍丘縣為杞縣，避廟諱也。
units.en: Yongqiu County in Bianzhou was renamed Qi County to avoid the imperial temple taboo.
units.literal: Yongqiu County of Bianzhou was renamed Qi County to avoid the imperial temple taboo.

units.zh: 戊寅，以兵部侍郎、判戶部李崧為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事，充樞密使；
units.en: On wuyin, Li Song, Vice Minister of War with charge of the Ministry of Revenue, became Vice Minister of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, and Military Affairs Commissioner;
units.literal: On the wuyin day, Li Song, Vice Minister of War and in charge of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of the Chancellery with concurrent Grand Councilor and appointed Military Affairs Commissioner;

units.zh: 以權知樞密使事、中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事、集賢殿學士桑維翰為樞密使。
units.en: and Sang Weihan, acting military affairs commissioner, Vice Minister of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, and Academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies, was confirmed as Military Affairs Commissioner.
units.literal: Sang Weihan, acting Military Affairs Commissioner, Vice Minister of the Chancellery with concurrent Grand Councilor and Academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies, was made Military Affairs Commissioner.

units.zh: 是日，詔曰：「應天開國，恭己臨人，宜覃繼絕之恩，以廣延洪之道。
units.en: That day an edict stated: "Having received Heaven's mandate to found the state and humbly governing the people, it is fitting to extend grace to severed lineages in order to broaden the way of lasting greatness.
units.literal: That day an edict stated: "Having received Heaven's mandate to found the state and humbly governing the people, it is fitting to extend grace to severed lineages in order to broaden the way of lasting greatness.

units.zh: 宜於唐朝宗屬中取一人封公世襲，兼隋之酅公為二王後，以後周介公備三恪，主其祭祀，及赴大朝會。」
units.en: One person should be chosen from among the Tang imperial clan to be enfeoffed as duke with hereditary succession; together with the Duke of Xi of Sui as the two Wang Hou, and with the Jie Duke of Later Zhou as the San Ke, they shall preside over sacrifices and attend the great court assemblies."
units.literal: One person should be chosen from among the Tang imperial clan to be enfeoffed as duke with hereditary succession; together with the Duke of Xi of Sui as the two Wang Hou, and with the Jie Duke of Later Zhou as the San Ke, they shall preside over sacrifices and attend the great court assemblies."

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》載原敕云：其唐朝宗屬中，舊在朝及諸道為官者，各據資歷，考限滿日，從品秩序遷。
units.en: (According to the Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium, the original edict read: among the Tang imperial clan, those who had served at court or in the provinces were to advance by rank in order of qualification when their examination terms expired.
units.literal: (The Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium records the original edict as follows: Among the Tang imperial clan, those formerly at court or serving as officials in the various circuits were each, according to qualification, to be promoted in rank order when their examination terms were complete.

units.zh: 已有出身，任令參選。）〉
units.en: Those already qualified were permitted to stand for selection.)〉
units.literal: Those who already had credentials were permitted to enter selection.)〉

units.zh: 以前鎮國軍節度使皇甫立為神武統軍，以前宗正卿李郁為太子賓客。
units.en: Huangfu Li, former Military Commissioner of Zhenguo, became Commander of the Divine Martial Army, and Li Yu, former Director of the Imperial Clan, became Guest of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: Huangfu Li, former Military Commissioner of Zhenguo Army, was made Commander of the Divine Martial Army; Li Yu, former Director of the Imperial Clan, was made Guest of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 庚辰，以吏部侍郎龍敏判戶部。
units.en: On gengchen, Long Min, Vice Minister of Personnel, was given charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
units.literal: On the gengchen day, Long Min, Vice Minister of Personnel, was given charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 二月丙戌，以尚食使安友規充葬明宗皇后監護使，以河陽節度使安審暉為鄜州節度使。
units.en: On bingxu in the second month, An Yougui, Commissioner of Imperial Food, was made supervisor for the burial of Empress Mingzong, and An Shenhui of Heyang became Military Commissioner of Fuzhou.
units.literal: On the bingxu day of the second month, An Yougui, Commissioner of Imperial Food, was made Supervisor for the burial of Empress Mingzong; An Shenhui, Military Commissioner of Heyang, was made Military Commissioner of Fuzhou.

units.zh: 癸巳，詔停北京西北面計度司事。
units.en: On guisi an edict suspended the Northwestern Planning Office of the Northern Capital.
units.literal: On the guisi day, an edict halted the Northwestern Planning Office of the Northern Capital.

units.zh: 吳越國王錢元瓘加食邑實封，改賜功臣名號。
units.en: Qian Yuanguan, King of Wuyue, received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment and a new honorific title.
units.literal: Qian Yuanguan, King of Wuyue, received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment and was granted a new honorific title of meritorious minister.

units.zh: 己亥，詔：「應諸道行軍副使等得替後，且就私家取便安止，限一年後方得赴闕，當便與比擬。」
units.en: On the jihai day, an edict stated: "Campaigning vice commissioners and the like in all circuits, after completing their terms, should first rest at home as convenient; only after one year may they come to court, at which time they shall promptly be given comparable appointments."
units.literal: On the jihai day, an edict stated: "Campaigning vice commissioners and the like in all circuits, after completing their terms, should first rest at home as convenient; only after one year may they come to court, at which time they shall promptly be given comparable appointments."

units.zh: 壬寅，詔：「應諸道馬步都虞候，自今後朝廷更不差補，委自藩方，於本州衙前大將中，慎選久歷事任、曉會刑獄者充，以三年為限，仍不得於元隨職員內差補。」
units.en: On the renyin day, an edict stated: "For cavalry and infantry chief adjutants in all circuits, from now on the court shall no longer appoint them directly but shall entrust the circuits; from senior generals at each prefectural headquarters, men long experienced in office and versed in penal matters are to be chosen carefully, for a term of three years, and they may not be appointed from among former personal staff."
units.literal: On the renyin day, an edict stated: "For cavalry and infantry chief adjutants in all circuits, from now on the court shall no longer appoint them directly but shall entrust the circuits; from senior generals at each prefectural headquarters, men long experienced in office and versed in penal matters are to be chosen carefully, for a term of three years, and they may not be appointed from among former personal staff."

units.zh: 以左散騎常侍孔昭序為太子賓客，尚書左僕射劉句、右僕射盧質並加食邑實封。
units.en: Kong Zhaoxu, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, became Guest of the Heir Apparent, and Liu Ju, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Lu Zhi, Right Vice Director, both received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment.
units.literal: Kong Zhaoxu, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Guest of the Heir Apparent; Liu Ju, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Lu Zhi, Right Vice Director, both received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment.

units.zh: 甲辰，以滄州留後馬全節為橫海軍節度使，以太子賓客韓惲為貝州刺史，左羽林統軍羅周敬為右金吾衛上將軍。
units.en: On jiachen, Ma Quanjie, acting commissioner of Cangzhou, became Military Commissioner of Henghai; Han Yun, Guest of the Heir Apparent, became Prefect of Beizhou; and Luo Zhoujing, commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, became Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard.
units.literal: On the jiachen day, Ma Quanjie, acting commissioner of Cangzhou, was made Military Commissioner of Henghai Army; Han Yun, Guest of the Heir Apparent, was made Prefect of Beizhou; Luo Zhoujing, Commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, was made Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard.

units.zh: 丙午，以皇子左驍衛上將軍重信為檢校太保、河陽三城節度使，以權知河陽軍州事周瑰為安州節度使。
units.en: On bingwu, Imperial Prince Chongxin, Senior General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard, became Acting Grand Guardian and Military Commissioner of the Three Cities of Heyang, and Zhou Gui, acting overseer of Heyang, became Military Commissioner of Anzhou.
units.literal: On the bingwu day, the imperial prince Chongxin, Senior General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard, was made Acting Grand Guardian and Military Commissioner of the Three Cities of Heyang; Zhou Gui, acting in charge of Heyang military and prefectural affairs, was made Military Commissioner of Anzhou.

units.zh: 詔：「中外臣僚，或因差使出入，並不得薦屬人於藩鎮，希求事任。
units.en: An edict stated: "Civil and military officials at home and abroad, when traveling on assignment, must not recommend dependents to military governors in hope of obtaining posts.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Civil and military officials at home and abroad, when traveling on assignment, must not recommend dependents to military governors in hope of obtaining posts.

units.zh: 如有犯者，並準唐長興二年敕條處分。」
units.en: Violators were all to be dealt with according to the edict articles of the second year of Changxing of Tang."
units.literal: Violators were all to be dealt with according to the edict articles of the second year of Changxing of Tang."

units.zh: 戊申，中書舍人陳乂改左散騎常侍。
units.en: On wushen, Chen Yi, Secretariat Drafter, became Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
units.literal: On the wushen day, Chen Yi, Secretariat Drafter, was transferred to Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.

units.zh: 應在朝文武百僚及見任刺史，先代未封贈者，與加封贈；
units.en: Civil and military officials at court and incumbent prefects whose ancestors had not been posthumously enfeoffed were to receive enfeoffment;
units.literal: All civil and military officials at court and incumbent prefects whose forebears had not received posthumous enfeoffment were to receive such enfeoffment;

units.zh: 母、妻未敘封者，並與敘封。
units.en: and mothers and wives not yet granted titles were to receive them.
units.literal: mothers and wives not yet granted titles were all to receive titles.

units.zh: 辛亥，天和節，帝御長春殿，召左右街僧錄威儀殿內譚經，循舊式也。
units.en: On xinhai, the Tianhe Festival, the emperor entered the Everlasting Spring Hall and summoned the monastic registrars of both streets to expound sutras in the Hall of Majestic Rites, following precedent.
units.literal: On the xinhai day, the Tianhe Festival, the Emperor took the throne in the Everlasting Spring Hall and summoned the monastic registrars of the left and right streets to expound sutras within the Hall of Majestic Rites, following the old form.

units.zh: 三月甲寅，制北京留守、太原尹、皇子重貴封食邑三百戶，刑部侍郎張鵬改兵部侍郎。
units.en: On jiayin in the third month, Imperial Prince Chonggui, Northern Capital Regent and Prefect of Taiyuan, was granted a fief of three hundred households, and Zhang Peng, Vice Minister of Justice, became Vice Minister of War.
units.literal: On the jiayin day of the third month, an edict enfeoffed Imperial Prince Chonggui, Northern Capital Regent and Prefect of Taiyuan, with a fief of three hundred households; Zhang Peng, Vice Minister of Justice, was transferred to Vice Minister of War.

units.zh: 己未，御史臺奏：「唐朝定令式，南衙常參文武百僚，每日朝退，於廊下賜食，謂之常食。
units.en: On the jiwei day, the Censorate memorialized: "Tang statutes fixed that the hundred civil and military officials of the southern court who attended daily, after retiring from audience each day, were granted food in the corridor—called regular food.
units.literal: On the jiwei day, the Censorate memorialized: "Tang statutes fixed that the hundred civil and military officials of the southern court who attended daily, after retiring from audience each day, were granted food in the corridor—called regular food.

units.zh: 自唐末亂離，常食漸廢，仍於入閣起居日賜食。
units.en: Since the turmoil at the end of Tang, regular food had fallen into disuse, and food was granted only on days of entering the hall for daily audience.
units.literal: Since the turmoil at the end of Tang, regular food was gradually abandoned, and food was still granted on days of entering the hall for daily audience.

units.zh: 每入閣禮畢，閣門宣放仗，群官俱拜，謂之謝食。
units.en: When the hall-entry rites ended, the Gate Office announced dismissal of the guard and all officials bowed together—called thanking for food.
units.literal: Whenever the hall-entry rites were complete, the Gate Office announced dismissal of the guard; all officials bowed together—called thanking for food.

units.zh: 至偽主清泰年中，入閣禮畢，更差中使至正衙門口宣賜食，百官立班重謝，此則交失唐朝賜食之意，於禮實為太煩。
units.en: Under the usurper Qingtai, after hall-entry rites envoys were sent to the main court gate to announce food, and officials stood in formation to thank again—altogether losing the Tang intent and making the ritual far too cumbersome.
units.literal: By the reign of the false ruler Qingtai, after the hall-entry rites were complete, palace envoys were again dispatched to the main court gate to announce the grant of food; the hundred officials stood in formation and thanked again—this completely lost the Tang meaning of granting food and was in ritual truth far too cumbersome.

units.zh: 臣恐因循，漸失根本。
units.en: We fear that if this continues, the fundamental practice will be lost.
units.literal: Your subject fears that if this is followed, the fundamental practice will gradually be lost.

units.zh: 起今後入閣賜食，望不差中使口宣，準唐明宗朝事例處分。」
units.en: From now on, for food granted on hall-entry days, we hope that palace envoys will not be sent to announce it orally, but that it be handled according to the precedents of the Tang reign of Emperor Mingzong."
units.literal: From now on, for food granted on hall-entry days, we hope that palace envoys will not be sent to announce it orally, but that it be handled according to the precedents of the Tang reign of Emperor Mingzong."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: [The memorial] was approved.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》載：其年四月，御史臺奏：「文武百官，每月朔望入閣禮畢，賜廊下食。
units.en: (The Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium records: In the fourth month of that year the Censorate memorialized: "Civil and military officials of the hundred ranks, on the first and fifteenth of each month after the hall-entry rites are complete, are granted food in the corridor.
units.literal: (The Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium records: In the fourth month of that year the Censorate memorialized: "Civil and military officials of the hundred ranks, on the first and fifteenth of each month after the hall-entry rites are complete, are granted food in the corridor.

units.zh: 在京時只於朝堂幕次兩廊下，今在行朝，於正衙門外權為幕次，房廊隘狹，伏恐五月一日朝會禮畢，準例賜食於幕次，難為排比。
units.en: In the capital this had been only in the corridor pavilions of the court; at the traveling court a temporary pavilion stood outside the main gate, and the quarters were cramped—we fear that after the assembly on the first of the fifth month, food could not be arranged there as usual.
units.literal: When in the capital this was only in the two corridors of the court tent pavilions; now at the traveling court a tent pavilion is temporarily set outside the main court gate, and the rooms and corridors are narrow and cramped—we fear that when the assembly rites are complete on the first day of the fifth month, granting food at the tent pavilion according to precedent will be difficult to arrange.

units.zh: 伏見唐明宗時，兩省官於文明殿前廊下賜食，今未審入閣日權於正衙門內兩廊下排比賜食，為復別有處分？」
units.en: We observe that in the time of Tang Emperor Mingzong, officials of the two departments were granted food in the corridor before the Hall of Civil Splendor; it is not yet clear whether on hall-entry days food should temporarily be arranged in the two corridors inside the main court gate, or whether there is some other disposition?"
units.literal: We observe that in the time of Tang Emperor Mingzong, officials of the two departments were granted food in the corridor before the Hall of Civil Splendor; it is not yet clear whether on hall-entry days food should temporarily be arranged in the two corridors inside the main court gate, or whether there is some other disposition?"

units.zh: 敕：宜依唐明宗時舊規，廊下賜食。）〉
units.en: An edict ordered that food be granted in the corridor according to Tang precedents from the reign of Emperor Mingzong.)〉
units.literal: An edict: It is fitting to follow the old regulations of Tang Emperor Mingzong's time and grant food in the corridor.)〉

units.zh: 中書奏：「準敕。
units.en: The Chancellery memorialized: "According to the edict.
units.literal: The Chancellery memorialized: "According to the edict.

units.zh: 故庶人三月七日以王禮葬，其妻男等並以禮葬，請輟其日朝參一日。」
units.en: The former commoner is to be buried with princely rites on the seventh day of the third month; his wife, sons, and the rest are all to be buried with full rites—we request that court attendance be suspended for one day on that date."
units.literal: The former commoner is to be buried with princely rites on the seventh day of the third month; his wife, sons, and the rest are all to be buried with full rites—we request that court attendance be suspended for one day on that date."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: [The request] was approved.

units.zh: 以宣徽南院使楊彥詢為左監門衛上將軍，依前充宣徽使。
units.en: Yang Yanxun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Attendant Office, became Senior General of the Left Gate Guard while retaining his post as Palace Attendant Commissioner.
units.literal: Yang Yanxun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Attendant Office, was made Senior General of the Left Gate Guard and continued as before as Palace Attendant Commissioner.

units.zh: 兗州李從溫奏，節度副使王謙構軍士作亂，尋已處置。
units.en: Li Congwen of Yanzhou reported that Vice Commissioner Wang Qian had incited a soldier mutiny, which was soon suppressed.
units.literal: Li Congwen of Yanzhou reported that Vice Commissioner Wang Qian had incited soldiers to rebel; the matter was soon handled.

units.zh: 丙寅，詔：「王者省方設教，靡憚於勤勞；
units.en: On bingyin an edict declared: "A ruler who tours the realm to spread instruction does not shrink from toil;
units.literal: On the bingyin day, an edict stated: "The king who tours the realm to spread instruction does not shrink from toil;

units.zh: 養士撫民，必從其宜便。
units.en: in nurturing scholars and comforting the people, he must follow what is suitable.
units.literal: in nurturing scholars and comforting the people, he must follow what is suitable and convenient.

units.zh: 顧惟涼德，肇啟丕圖。
units.en: Considering my meager virtue, I have newly undertaken a great enterprise.
units.literal: Looking upon my meager virtue, I have newly opened a great design.

units.zh: 常務去於煩苛，冀漸臻於富庶。
units.en: I constantly strive to remove burdensome regulations, hoping gradually to reach prosperity.
units.literal: I constantly strive to remove vexation and severity, hoping gradually to reach abundance.

units.zh: 念京城俶擾之後，屬舟船焚爇之餘，饋運頓虧，支費殊闕。
units.en: Reflecting that after the capital's recent turmoil and the burning of boats and ships, transport of supplies has collapsed and expenditures are severely strained.
units.literal: Reflecting that after the capital's recent turmoil, and in the aftermath of burned boats and ships, transport of supplies has suddenly fallen short and expenditures are severely lacking.

units.zh: 將別謀於飛挽，慮轉困於生靈。
units.en: I was about to seek other means of rapid transport, yet feared further distress to the people.
units.literal: I was about to seek other means of rapid transport, yet feared that the people would be further distressed.

units.zh: 以此疚心，未嘗安席。
units.en: This troubles my heart, and I have never rested at ease.
units.literal: Because of this my heart is troubled, and I have never rested at ease.

units.zh: 今以夷門重地，梁苑雄藩，水陸交通，舟車畢集，爰資經度，須議按巡。
units.en: Now Yimen is a vital region and Liangyuan a mighty prefecture, with water and land routes connecting and transport converging; it is fitting to plan administration and necessary to tour and inspect.
units.literal: Now, because Yimen is a vital region and Liangyuan a mighty prefecture, with water and land routes connecting and boats and carts all gathering, it is fitting to plan administration and necessary to consider an inspection tour.

units.zh: 寧免暫勞，所期克濟。
units.en: I would rather endure brief toil in hope of success.
units.literal: I would rather endure brief toil, expecting success.

units.zh: 取今月二十六日巡幸汴州」云。
units.en: The tour to Bianzhou is set for the twenty-sixth of this month."
units.literal: Let the twenty-sixth day of this month be taken for a tour to Bianzhou."

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：範延光聚卒繕兵，悉召巡內刺史集魏州，將作亂。
units.en: (The Comprehensive Mirror records that Fan Yanguang gathered troops, repaired weapons, summoned all prefects in his circuit to Weizhou, and was about to rebel.
units.literal: (The Comprehensive Mirror records: Fan Yanguang gathered troops and repaired weapons, summoned all prefects within his circuit to assemble at Weizhou, and was about to rebel.

units.zh: 會帝謀徙都大梁，桑維翰曰：「大梁北控燕、趙，南通江、淮，水陸都會，資用富饒。
units.en: Just as the emperor was planning to move the capital to Daliang, Sang Weihan said: "Daliang commands Yan and Zhao to the north and connects with the Yangtze and Huai to the south; it is a hub of water and land routes, and supplies are abundant.
units.literal: Just as the Emperor was planning to move the capital to Daliang, Sang Weihan said: "Daliang controls Yan and Zhao to the north and connects with the Yangtze and Huai to the south; it is a convergence of water and land routes, and supplies are abundant.

units.zh: 今延光反形已露，大梁距魏不過十驛，彼若有變，大軍尋至，所謂疾雷不及掩耳也。」
units.en: Now Yanguang's rebellious intent is already exposed; Daliang is no more than ten post-stations from Wei—if trouble arises there, a great army can arrive at once; this is what is called thunder so swift one cannot cover one's ears."
units.literal: Now Yanguang's rebellious intent is already exposed; Daliang is no more than ten post-stations from Wei—if trouble arises there, a great army can arrive at once; this is what is called thunder so swift one cannot cover one's ears."

units.zh: 丙寅，下詔，托以洛陽漕運有闕，東巡汴州。）〉
units.en: On bingyin an edict was issued, citing shortfalls in Luoyang's canal transport, for an eastern tour to Bianzhou.)〉
units.literal: On bingyin an edict was issued, citing shortfalls in Luoyang's canal transport, for an eastern tour to Bianzhou.)〉

units.zh: 以前貝州刺史史圭為刑部侍郎，充諸道鹽鐵轉運副使；
units.en: Shi Gui, former Prefect of Beizhou, became Vice Minister of Justice and Deputy Commissioner of Salt, Iron, and Transport for all circuits;
units.literal: Shi Gui, former Prefect of Beizhou, was made Vice Minister of Justice and Deputy Commissioner of Salt, Iron, and Transport for all circuits;

units.zh: 前澤州刺史閻至為戶部侍郎。
units.en: and Yan Zhi, former Prefect of Zezhou, became Vice Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: Yan Zhi, former Prefect of Zezhou, was made Vice Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 詔：「車駕經過州府管界，所有名山大川、帝王陵廟、名臣祠墓，去路十里者，宜令本州排比祗候。
units.en: An edict stated: "Wherever the imperial carriage passes through the jurisdiction of a prefecture, all famous mountains and great rivers, imperial tombs and temples, and shrines and tombs of renowned ministers within ten li of the route are to be arranged for attendance by that prefecture.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Wherever the imperial carriage passes through the jurisdiction of a prefecture, all famous mountains and great rivers, imperial tombs and temples, and shrines and tombs of renowned ministers within ten li of the route are to be arranged for attendance by that prefecture.

units.zh: 駕經過日，以酒脯祭告。」
units.en: On the day the carriage passes, wine and dried meat are to be offered in announcement."
units.literal: On the day the carriage passes, wine and dried meat are to be offered in announcement."

units.zh: 左僕射劉句等議立宗廟，以立高祖已下四親廟，其始祖一廟，伏候聖裁。
units.en: Left Vice Director Liu Ju and others proposed establishing the ancestral temple with four temples for the four nearest ancestors below the High Ancestor and one for the founding ancestor, awaiting imperial decision.
units.literal: Left Vice Director Liu Ju and others discussed establishing the ancestral temple, proposing four temples for the four nearest ancestors below the High Ancestor, with one temple for the founding ancestor—awaiting the sage decision.

units.zh: 御史中丞張昭遠議，請依隋、唐之制，立四廟，推四世之中名位高者為太祖。
units.en: Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan proposed following Sui and Tang practice to establish four temples and name as Great Ancestor the highest-ranking figure among four generations.
units.literal: Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan proposed following the Sui and Tang systems to establish four temples and select as Great Ancestor the person of highest rank and title among the four generations.

units.zh: 詔下百官定議。
units.en: An edict ordered the hundred officials to settle the matter.
units.literal: An edict was sent down for the hundred officials to fix the discussion.

units.zh: 百官請依唐廟，追尊四廟為定。
units.en: The officials proposed following the Tang temple system and posthumously honoring four temples.
units.literal: The hundred officials requested following the Tang temple system and posthumously honoring four temples as the fixed arrangement.

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: [The proposal] was approved.

units.zh: 甲戌，以右龍武統軍楊思權為左衛上將軍。
units.en: On jiaxu, Yang Siquan, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, became Senior General of the Left Guard.
units.literal: On the jiaxu day, Yang Siquan, Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made Senior General of the Left Guard.

units.zh: 乙亥，前鄜州節度使張萬進加檢校太傅，前宋州節度使李從敏加檢校太尉。
units.en: On yihai, Zhang Wanjin, former Military Commissioner of Fuzhou, was made Acting Grand Mentor, and Li Congmin, former Military Commissioner of Songzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: On the yihai day, Zhang Wanjin, former Military Commissioner of Fuzhou, was made Acting Grand Mentor; Li Congmin, former Military Commissioner of Songzhou, was made Acting Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 以吏部郎中兼侍御史、知雜事薛融為左諫議大夫，以兵部郎中段希堯為右諫議大夫。
units.en: Xue Rong, Director in the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent supervising censor, became Left Remonstrance Censor, and Duan Xiyao, Director in the Ministry of War, became Right Remonstrance Censor.
units.literal: Xue Rong, Director in the Ministry of Personnel with concurrent Remonstrance Censor and chief supervising censor, was made Left Remonstrance Censor; Duan Xiyao, Director in the Ministry of War, was made Right Remonstrance Censor.

units.zh: 戊寅，以戶部尚書王權為兵部尚書，工部尚書崔居儉為戶部尚書，兵部尚書李鏻為太子少保，兵部尚書致仕裴皞為工部尚書，東上閣門使李守貞為右龍武將軍充職。
units.en: On wuyin, Wang Quan, Minister of Revenue, became Minister of War; Cui Jujian, Minister of Works, became Minister of Revenue; Li Lin, Minister of War, became Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Pei Hao, retired Minister of War, became Minister of Works; and Li Shouzhen, Commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate, became General of the Right Dragon Martial Army with concurrent duty.
units.literal: On the wuyin day, Wang Quan, Minister of Revenue, was made Minister of War; Cui Jujian, Minister of Works, was made Minister of Revenue; Li Lin, Minister of War, was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; Pei Hao, retired Minister of War, was made Minister of Works; Li Shouzhen, Commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate, was made General of the Right Dragon Martial Army with concurrent duty.

units.zh: 庚辰，車駕離京。
units.en: On gengchen the imperial procession left the capital.
units.literal: On the gengchen day, the imperial carriage departed the capital.

units.zh: 四月癸未朔，至鄭州。
units.en: On the first day of the fourth month the emperor reached Zhengzhou.
units.literal: On the first day of the fourth month, guiwei, [the Emperor] reached Zhengzhou.

units.zh: 防禦使白景友進牲餼器皿，帝曰：「不出民力否？」
units.en: Defender Bai Jingyou presented sacrificial animals, provisions, and vessels; the Emperor said: "This did not come from the people's labor, did it?"
units.literal: Defender Bai Jingyou presented sacrificial animals, provisions, and vessels; the Emperor said: "This did not come from the people's labor, did it?"

units.zh: 景友曰：「臣畏陛下法，皆辦於己俸。」
units.en: Jingyou replied, "I feared Your Majesty's laws and provided everything from my own salary."
units.literal: Jingyou said: "Your subject feared Your Majesty's laws and provided everything from his own salary."

units.zh: 命收之。
units.en: The emperor ordered them accepted.
units.literal: He ordered them accepted.

units.zh: 甲申，駕入汴州。
units.en: On jiashen the procession entered Bianzhou.
units.literal: On the jiashen day, the carriage entered Bianzhou.

units.zh: 丁亥，制：「應天福二年四月五日昧爽已前，諸道州府見禁囚徒，大辟已下，罪無輕重，並釋放。
units.en: On the dinghai day, an edict stated: "Before dawn on the fifth day of the fourth month of the second year of Tianfu, all prisoners held in custody in prefectures and circuits of every rank, from capital offenses downward, regardless of severity, are to be released.
units.literal: On the dinghai day, an edict stated: "Before dawn on the fifth day of the fourth month of the second year of Tianfu, all prisoners held in custody in prefectures and circuits of every rank, from capital offenses downward, regardless of severity, are to be released.

units.zh: 天福元年已前，諸道州府應系殘欠租稅，並特除免。
units.en: All outstanding rents and taxes owed before Tianfu 1 in every circuit and prefecture were specially remitted.
units.literal: All outstanding rents and taxes owed before the first year of Tianfu in circuits and prefectures are specially remitted.

units.zh: 諸道系征諸色人欠負省司錢物，宜令自偽清泰元年終已前所欠者，據所通納到物業外，並與除放。
units.en: Debts owed to central ministries by persons of every category in all circuits before the end of the usurper Qingtai reign, apart from property already paid in commutation, were all remitted.
units.literal: For persons of every category in all circuits owing money and goods to central ministries, those debts owed before the end of the false Qingtai reign, apart from property already commuted and paid, are all to be remitted.

units.zh: 昨者，行至鄭州滎陽縣界，路旁見有蟲食及旱損桑麥處，委所司差人檢覆，量與蠲免租稅。
units.en: Recently, traveling through Xingyang County in Zhengzhou, the emperor saw along the road places where insects and drought had damaged mulberry and wheat; relevant offices were to inspect and remit rents and taxes as appropriate.
units.literal: Recently, traveling to the border of Xingyang County in Zhengzhou, along the road places were seen where insects had eaten crops and drought had damaged mulberry and wheat—relevant offices are to send men to inspect and remit rents and taxes as appropriate.

units.zh: 河陽管內酒戶百姓，應欠天福元年閏十一月二十五日已前，不敷年額曲錢，並放。
units.en: Liquor-household commoners in the Heyang circuit who owed liquor taxes unpaid by the twenty-fifth day of the intercalary eleventh month of Tianfu 1, failing to meet the annual quota, were all released.
units.literal: Liquor-household commoners within the Heyang circuit who owed liquor taxes not paid by the twenty-fifth day of the intercalary eleventh month of the first year of Tianfu, failing to meet the annual quota, are all released.

units.zh: 其諸處應經兵火者，亦與指揮。
units.en: Places that had suffered military fire were likewise to receive orders for relief.
units.literal: Places that have suffered military fire are likewise to receive orders [for relief].

units.zh: 當罪即誅，式明常典；
units.en: Those who should be punished are to be executed at once, thereby clarifying the constant statutes;
units.literal: Those who should be punished are to be executed at once, thereby clarifying the constant statutes;

units.zh: 既往可憫，宜示深仁。
units.en: but the past may be pitied, and deep benevolence should be shown.
units.literal: the past may be pitied, and deep benevolence should be displayed.

units.zh: 偽清泰中，臣僚內有從誅戮者，並許收葬。
units.en: Officials executed during the usurper Qingtai reign were permitted burial.
units.literal: Among officials executed during the false Qingtai reign, burial is permitted for all.

units.zh: 天下百姓，有年八十已上者，與免一子差徭，仍逐處簡署上佐官。
units.en: Commoners aged eighty or above throughout the realm were to have one son exempted from corvée labor, with a senior assisting official selected in each place.
units.literal: Commoners throughout the realm aged eighty or above are to have one son exempted from corvée labor, and in each place a senior assisting official is to be selected and appointed.

units.zh: 梁故滑州節度使王彥章，效命當時，致身所事，稟千年之正氣，流百代之令名，宜令超贈太師，子孫量才敘錄。
units.en: Wang Yanzhang, former Military Commissioner of Huazhou under Liang, gave his life to his lord and embodied the upright spirit of the ages, leaving a renowned name for generations—he was posthumously promoted to Grand Preceptor, and his descendants were to be appointed according to talent.
units.literal: Wang Yanzhan, former Military Commissioner of Huazhou under Liang, devoted his life to his lord at the time and gave his person to the cause he served, embodying the upright spirit of a thousand years and leaving a renowned name for a hundred generations—he should be posthumously promoted to Grand Preceptor, and his descendants appointed according to talent.

units.zh: 應諸道州府管界，有自偽命抽點鄉兵之時，多是結集劫盜，因此畏懼刑章，藏隱山谷，宜令逐處曉諭招攜，各令復業。
units.en: In every circuit and prefecture, when local militia were conscripted under the usurper regime many had banded together as robbers; fearing punishment they hid in the mountains—each place was to proclaim and win them back to resume their occupations.
units.literal: In the jurisdictions of circuits and prefectures, when local militia were conscripted under the false regime many banded together as robbers; fearing penal statutes they hid in mountains and valleys—each place is to proclaim and win them back, each to resume his occupation.

units.zh: 自今年四月五日已前為非者，一切不問。
units.en: Wrongs committed before the fifth day of the fourth month of this year were not to be prosecuted.
units.literal: Wrongs committed before the fifth day of the fourth month of this year are not to be questioned at all.

units.zh: 如兩月不歸業者，復罪如初。」
units.en: If after two months they do not return to their occupations, guilt is restored as before."
units.literal: If after two months they do not return to their occupations, guilt is restored as before."

units.zh: 丁酉，宣武軍節度使、侍衛親軍使楊光遠加兼侍中。
units.en: On dingyou, Yang Guangyuan, Military Commissioner of Xuanwu and Commander of the Palace Guard Personal Army, was made concurrent Palace Attendant.
units.literal: On the dingyou day, Yang Guangyuan, Military Commissioner of Xuanwu Army and Commander of the Palace Guard Personal Army, was made concurrent Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 己亥，陜州節度使、侍衛都虞候劉知遠加檢校太保。
units.en: On jihai, Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of Shanzhou and Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard, was made Acting Grand Guardian.
units.literal: On the jihai day, Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of Shanzhou and Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard, was made Acting Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 庚子，北京、鄴都、徐兗二州並奏旱。
units.en: On gengzi the Northern Capital, Yedu, and Xu and Yan prefectures all reported drought.
units.literal: On the gengzi day, the Northern Capital, Yedu, and the two prefectures of Xu and Yan all reported drought.

units.zh: 詔：「今後立妃，及拜免三公宰相，及命將、封親王公主，宜令並降制命，余從令式處分。」
units.en: An edict stated: "Hereafter, establishing consorts, appointing and dismissing the Three Dukes and chief councilors, appointing generals, and enfeoffing imperial princes and princesses should all be by issued edict; the rest follow statutory regulations."
units.literal: An edict stated: "Hereafter, establishing consorts, appointing and dismissing the Three Dukes and chief councilors, appointing generals, and enfeoffing imperial princes and princesses should all be by issued edict; the rest follow statutory regulations."

units.zh: 夏五月壬子朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
units.en: On the first day of the fifth month the emperor received congratulations in the Chongyuan Hall with full ceremonial guard.
units.literal: On the first day of the fifth month of summer, renzi, the Emperor took the throne in the Chongyuan Hall to receive congratulatory homage, with guards and insignia in full form.

units.zh: 詔洛京、魏府管內所征今年夏苗稅麥等，宜放五分之一，以微旱故也。
units.en: Summer seedling taxes and wheat levies collected this year in the Luoyang capital and Weifu circuits were remitted by one-fifth because of slight drought.
units.literal: An edict stated that summer seedling taxes and wheat levies collected this year within the Luoyang capital and Weifu circuits should be remitted by one-fifth, because of slight drought.

units.zh: 丙辰，御史中丞張昭遠奏：「汴州在梁室朱氏稱制之年，有京都之號，及唐莊宗平定河南，復廢為宣武軍。
units.en: On the bingchen day, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan memorialized: "Bianzhou, in the years when the Zhu clan of Liang held power, bore the title of capital; when Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong pacified Henan it was again abolished and made Xuanwu Army.
units.literal: On the bingchen day, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan memorialized: "Bianzhou, in the years when the Zhu clan of Liang held power, bore the title of capital; when Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong pacified Henan it was again abolished and made Xuanwu Army.

units.zh: 至明宗行幸之時，掌事者因緣修葺衙城，遂掛梁室時宮殿門牌額，當時識者或竊非之。
units.en: When Emperor Mingzong toured, those in charge repaired the headquarters city and hung palace gate placards from Liang times—men of discernment privately disapproved.
units.literal: When Emperor Mingzong toured, those in charge took occasion to repair the headquarters city and hung palace gate placards from Liang times—men of discernment at the time privately disapproved.

units.zh: 一昨車駕省方，暫居梁苑，臣觀衙城內齋閣牌額，一如明宗行幸之時，無都號而有殿名，恐非典據。
units.en: When the emperor recently toured and temporarily resided in Liangyuan, I observed placards on pavilions within the headquarters city as in Mingzong's tour—no capital designation but hall names—and fear this is not canonical precedent.
units.literal: When the carriage recently toured the realm and temporarily resided in Liangyuan, your subject observed placards on pavilions within the headquarters city just as in Mingzong's tour—no capital designation but hall names—and fears this is not canonical precedent.

units.zh: 臣竊尋秦、漢已來，寰海之內，鑾輿所至，多立宮名。
units.en: Since Qin and Han, wherever the imperial carriage went within the realm, palace names were often established.
units.literal: Your subject has traced since Qin and Han that wherever the imperial carriage went within the realm, palace names were often established.

units.zh: 近代隋室於揚州立江都宮，太原立汾陽宮，岐州立仁壽宮。
units.en: In recent times the Sui established the Jiangdu Palace at Yangzhou, the Fenyang Palace at Taiyuan, and the Renshou Palace at Qizhou.
units.literal: In recent times the Sui house established the Jiangdu Palace at Yangzhou, the Fenyang Palace at Taiyuan, and the Renshou Palace at Qizhou.

units.zh: 唐朝於太原立晉陽宮，同州立長春宮，岐州立九成宮。
units.en: The Tang established the Jinyang Palace at Taiyuan, the Everlasting Spring Palace at Tongzhou, and the Ninefold Palace at Qizhou.
units.literal: The Tang house established the Jinyang Palace at Taiyuan, the Everlasting Spring Palace at Tongzhou, and the Ninefold Palace at Qizhou.

units.zh: 宮中殿閣，皆題署牌額，以類皇居。
units.en: Halls and pavilions within the palaces all bore inscribed placards, resembling the imperial residence.
units.literal: Halls and pavilions within the palaces all bore inscribed placards, resembling the imperial residence.

units.zh: 請準故事，於汴州衙城門權掛一宮門牌額，則其餘齋閣並可取便為名。」
units.en: We request following precedent to hang temporarily one palace gate placard at the Bianzhou headquarters gate; then the remaining pavilions may all be named as convenient."
units.literal: We request following precedent to hang temporarily one palace gate placard at the Bianzhou headquarters gate; then the remaining pavilions may all be named as convenient."

units.zh: 敕：行闕宜以大寧宮為名。
units.en: An edict named the traveling palace the Great Tranquility Palace.
units.literal: An edict: The traveling palace should be named the Great Tranquility Palace.

units.zh: 湖南青草廟舊封安流侯，進封廣利公；
units.en: The Green Grass Temple in Hunan, formerly Marquis of Anliu, was advanced to Duke of Guangli;
units.literal: The Green Grass Temple in Hunan, formerly enfeoffed as Marquis of Anliu, was advanced to Duke of Guangli;

units.zh: 洞庭廟進封靈濟公；
units.en: The Dongting Shrine was promoted to Duke Spirit-Benefit;
units.literal: The Dongting Shrine was advanced in title to Duke Spirit-Benefit;

units.zh: 磊石廟舊封昭靈侯，進封威顯公；
units.en: The Leishi Shrine, previously Marquis Splendid Spirit, was promoted to Duke Majestic Manifestation;
units.literal: The Leishi Shrine, formerly enfeoffed as Marquis Splendid Spirit, was advanced to Duke Majestic Manifestation;

units.zh: 黃陵二妃廟舊封懿節廟，改封昭烈廟，從馬希範之請也。
units.en: At Ma Xifan's request, the shrine of the Two Consorts at Huangling, formerly the Yi Jie Shrine, was retitled the Splendid Fierce Shrine.
units.literal: The shrine of the Two Consorts at Huangling, formerly titled the Yi Jie Shrine, was renamed the Splendid Fierce Shrine, in accordance with Ma Xifan's request.

units.zh: 戊午，以前成德軍節度判官張彭為太府卿。
units.en: On wuwu, Zhang Peng, former Chengde military administration judge, became Minister of the Imperial Treasury.
units.literal: On the wuwu day, Zhang Peng, formerly adjutant to the military governor of Chengde Circuit, was appointed Minister of the Imperial Treasury.

units.zh: 壬戌，詔在朝文武臣僚，每人各進封事一件。
units.en: On renxu the court decreed that every civil and military official in attendance submit one sealed memorial.
units.literal: On the renxu day, an edict ordered all civil and military officials at court to each submit one sealed memorial.

units.zh: 仍須實封通進，務裨闕政，用副虛懷。
units.en: Memorials were to be submitted under real seal, to remedy failings in government and answer the emperor's open-minded solicitude.
