units.literal: They were also required to submit them fully sealed, striving to remedy governmental deficiencies, to match his humble receptivity.

units.zh: 甲子，以虞部郎中、知制誥於嶠為中書舍人，以戶部郎中於遘為虞部郎中、知制誥，故太子少保致仕朱漢賓贈司空。
units.en: On jiazi, Yu Qiao, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works and rescript drafter, became Secretariat Drafter; Yu Hou, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue, became Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works and rescript drafter; and the late retired Junior Guardian Zhu Hanbin was posthumously granted Sikong.
units.literal: On the jiazi day, Yu Qiao, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works and drafter of edicts, was made Deputy Director of the Secretariat; Yu Hou, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue, was made Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works and drafter of edicts; the late retired Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent Zhu Hanbin was posthumously granted Sikong.

units.zh: 乙丑，六宅使王繼宏送義州衙前收管，前洺州團練使高信送復州收管。
units.en: On yichou, Palace Attendant Wang Jihong was remanded to Yi prefectural custody, and former Mingzhou defensive commissioner Gao Xin to Fu prefecture.
units.literal: On the yichou day, Palace Attendant Wang Jihong was sent to be detained at the Yi prefectural yamen, and former Mingzhou defensive commissioner Gao Xin was sent to be detained at Fu prefecture.

units.zh: 二人於崇禮門內喧爭，為臺司所劾故也。
units.en: This was because they had quarreled noisily inside the Chongli Gate and had been impeached by the censorate.
units.literal: The reason was that the two men had quarreled loudly inside the Chongli Gate and had been impeached by the censorate.

units.zh: 戊辰，翰林學士、戶部員外郎、知制誥竇貞固改工部郎中、知制誥；
units.en: On wuchen, Hanlin Academician Dou Zhengu, Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue and rescript drafter, became Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works and rescript drafter;
units.literal: On the wuchen day, Hanlin Academician Dou Zhengu, Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts, was transferred to Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works and drafter of edicts;

units.zh: 翰林學士、都官郎中、知制誥李慎儀改中書舍人，仍賜金紫，並依舊充職。
units.en: Hanlin Academician Li Shenyi, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice and rescript drafter, became Secretariat Drafter, was again granted the gold seal and purple robe, and both men continued in their former capacities.
units.literal: Hanlin Academician Li Shenyi, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice and drafter of edicts, was transferred to Deputy Director of the Secretariat, and was still granted the gold seal and purple robe; both continued in their previous posts.

units.zh: 庚午，制封皇第二十一女為長安公主，封皇第十一妹烏氏為壽安長公主，皇第十二妹史氏為永壽長公主，皇第十三妹杜氏為樂平長公主。
units.en: On gengwu an edict enfeoffed the emperor's twenty-first daughter as Princess of Chang'an; his eleventh younger sister, Lady Wu, as Grand Princess of Shou'an; his twelfth younger sister, Lady Shi, as Grand Princess of Yongshou; and his thirteenth younger sister, Lady Du, as Grand Princess of Leping.
units.literal: On the gengwu day, by edict the emperor's twenty-first daughter was enfeoffed as Princess of Chang'an; the emperor's eleventh younger sister, Lady Wu, as Grand Princess of Shou'an; the twelfth younger sister, Lady Shi, as Grand Princess of Yongshou; and the thirteenth younger sister, Lady Du, as Grand Princess of Leping.

units.zh: 壬申，天雄軍節度使、守太傅、兼中書令、興唐尹範延光進封臨清王，加食邑三千戶；
units.en: On renshen, Fan Yanguang, Military Commissioner of Tianxiong, acting Grand Preceptor, Palace Secretariat Director, and Prefect of Xingtang, was promoted Prince of Linqing with an additional fief of three thousand households;
units.literal: On the renshen day, Fan Yanguang, Military Commissioner of Tianxiong Army, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Palace Secretariat Director, and Prefect of Xingtang, was advanced to Prince of Linqing, with an additional fief of three thousand households;

units.zh: 鳳翔節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、西平王李從嚴進封岐王。
units.en: Li Congyan, Military Commissioner of Fengxiang, Acting Grand Mentor, Palace Secretariat Director, and Prince of Xiping, was promoted Prince of Qi.
units.literal: Li Congyan, Military Commissioner of Fengxiang, Acting Grand Mentor, concurrent Palace Secretariat Director, and Prince of Xiping, was advanced to Prince of Qi.

units.zh: 丙子，平盧軍節度使、兼中書令王建立進封臨淄王；
units.en: On bingzi, Wang Jianli, Military Commissioner of Pinglu and Palace Secretariat Director, was promoted Prince of Linzi;
units.literal: On the bingzi day, Wang Jianli, Military Commissioner of Pinglu Army and concurrent Palace Secretariat Director, was advanced to Prince of Linzi;

units.zh: 昭信軍節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使景延廣改寧江軍節度使，典軍如故。
units.en: Jing Yanguang, Military Commissioner of Zhaoxin and commander of the palace cavalry guard, became Military Commissioner of Ningjiang while continuing to command troops as before.
units.literal: Jing Yanguang, Military Commissioner of Zhaoxin and Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry, was transferred to Military Commissioner of Ningjiang; he continued to command troops as before.

units.zh: 太常卿梁文矩奏定四廟謚號、廟號、陵號，太常少卿裴垣奏定四廟皇后追尊謚號，從之。
units.en: Minister of Rites Liang Wenju proposed posthumous titles, temple names, and tomb names for the four imperial temples; Vice Minister of Rites Pei Yuan proposed posthumous titles for the empresses honored there; both were approved.
units.literal: Minister of Rites Liang Wenju memorialized on fixing the posthumous titles, temple names, and tomb names for the four imperial temples; Vice Minister of Rites Pei Yuan memorialized on fixing the posthumous honorific titles for the empresses of the four temples; the court approved.

units.zh: 戊寅，以中書舍人、權知貢舉王延為御史中丞，以翰林學士、戶部侍郎、知制誥崔棁為兵部侍郎充承旨，以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎程遜為檢校禮部尚書、太常卿，以檢校吏部尚書、太常卿梁文矩為吏部尚書，以御史中丞張昭遠為戶部侍郎，以吏部尚書盧文紀為太子少傅。
units.en: On wuyin, Wang Yan, Secretariat Drafter and acting chief examiner, became Censor-in-Chief; Cui Zhi, Hanlin Academician, Vice Minister of Revenue, and rescript drafter, became Vice Minister of War and chief drafter; Cheng Xun, Hanlin chief drafter and Vice Minister of War, became Acting Minister of Rites and Minister of Rites; Liang Wenju became Minister of Personnel; Zhang Zhaoyuan became Vice Minister of Revenue; and Lu Wenji became Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.
units.literal: On the wuyin day, Wang Yan, Secretariat Drafter and acting chief examiner, was made Censor-in-Chief; Cui Zhi, Hanlin Academician, Vice Minister of Revenue, and drafter of edicts, was made Vice Minister of War and chief drafter; Cheng Xun, Hanlin Academician, chief drafter, and Vice Minister of War, was made Acting Minister of Rites and Minister of Rites; Liang Wenju, Acting Minister of Personnel and Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Personnel; Zhang Zhaoyuan, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Lu Wenji, Minister of Personnel, was made Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 己卯，詔太社內先收掌唐朝罪人首級等，宜令骨肉或先舊僚屬收葬，其喪葬儀註不得過制。
units.en: On jimao an edict ordered that severed heads of Tang convicts kept at the Altar of Earth be released to kin or former colleagues for burial, with funeral observances kept within proper bounds.
units.literal: On the jimao day, an edict stated that the severed heads of Tang dynasty convicts previously held at the Altar of Earth should be released to their kin or former colleagues for burial, and that funeral rites must not exceed proper form.

units.zh: 六月壬午朔，制：「宗正卿石光贊奏：滎陽道左有萬石君石奮之廟，德行懿美，宜示封崇，用光遠祖之徽猷，益茂我朝之盛典。
units.en: On the first day of the sixth month, the renshen day, an edict read: "Director of the Imperial Clan Shi Guangzan memorialized: beside the road at Xingyang stands the shrine of Lord Ten Thousand Bushels, Shi Fen; his virtue and conduct were splendid; it is fitting to honor him with elevation in rank, to glorify the fine legacy of distant ancestors and further enrich the grand ceremonies of our dynasty.
units.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, the renshen day, an edict read: "Director of the Imperial Clan Shi Guangzan memorialized: beside the road at Xingyang stands the shrine of Lord Ten Thousand Bushels, Shi Fen; his virtue and conduct were splendid; it is fitting to honor him with elevation in rank, to glorify the fine legacy of distant ancestors and further enrich the grand ceremonies of our dynasty.

units.zh: 贈奮太傅。」
units.en: Fen was posthumously granted the title of Grand Preceptor."
units.literal: Fen was posthumously granted the title of Grand Preceptor."

units.zh: 癸未，契丹使夷離華來聘，致馬二百匹，及人參、貂鼠皮、走馬、木碗等物。
units.en: On guiwei the Khitan envoy Yili Hua arrived on a diplomatic mission, presenting two hundred horses along with ginseng, sable and rat furs, riding horses, wooden bowls, and other goods.
units.literal: On the guiwei day, the Khitan envoy Yili Hua came on a diplomatic mission, presenting two hundred horses, as well as ginseng, sable and rat furs, riding horses, wooden bowls, and other goods.

units.zh: 乙酉，翰林學士、司封員外郎、知制誥王仁裕改都官郎中，右贊善大夫盧損改右散騎常侍，前有朝貶故也。
units.en: On yiyou, Hanlin Academician Wang Renyu, Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel and rescript drafter, became Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice, and Right Mentor Lu Sun became Right Regular Attendant, both having been demoted at court earlier.
units.literal: On the yiyou day, Hanlin Academician Wang Renyu, Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel and drafter of edicts, was transferred to Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice; Right Mentor Lu Sun was transferred to Right Regular Attendant; this was because they had previously been demoted at court.

units.zh: 以秘書少監致仕劉頎為鴻臚卿致仕，前光祿少卿尹玉羽以少府監致仕。
units.en: Liu Yong, retired Deputy Director of the Secretariat, was granted the honorary title of retired Director of the Court of State Ceremonial; Yin Yuyu, former Vice Director of the Directorate of Imperial Entertainments, retired as Director of the Imperial Manufactories.
units.literal: Liu Yong, retired Deputy Director of the Secretariat, was given the honorary title of retired Director of the Court of State Ceremonial; former Vice Director of the Directorate of Imperial Entertainments Yin Yuyu retired with the title of Director of the Imperial Manufactories.

units.zh: 丙戌，宰臣李崧上表讓樞密使於趙瑩，以瑩佐命之元臣也。
units.en: On bingxu, Chief Minister Li Song petitioned to yield the post of Military Affairs Commissioner to Zhao Ying, calling him a founding minister of the realm.
units.literal: On the bingxu day, Chief Minister Li Song submitted a memorial yielding the post of Military Affairs Commissioner to Zhao Ying, on the grounds that Ying was a founding minister who had assisted in establishing the dynasty.

units.zh: 詔不允。
units.en: The edict did not grant his request.
units.literal: The edict did not approve.

units.zh: 以前義成軍節度使李彥舜為左武衛大將軍，以左散騎常侍唐汭為檢校禮部尚書、國子祭酒，以前左龍武統軍李承約為左驍衛上將軍。
units.en: Li Yanshun, former Military Commissioner of Yicheng, became General of the Left Martial Guard; Tang Rui, Left Regular Attendant, became Acting Minister of Rites and Chancellor of the Directorate of Education; and Li Chengyue, former commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard, became General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.
units.literal: Li Yanshun, former Military Commissioner of Yicheng, was made General of the Left Martial Guard; Tang Rui, Left Regular Attendant, was made Acting Minister of Rites and Chancellor of the Directorate of Education; Li Chengyue, former Commander of the Left Dragon Martial Guard, was made General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.

units.zh: 戊子，宰臣趙瑩自契丹使回。
units.en: On wuzi, Chief Minister Zhao Ying returned from his embassy to the Khitans.
units.literal: On the wuzi day, Chief Minister Zhao Ying returned from his mission to the Khitans.

units.zh: 癸巳，東都奏，、瀍澗河溢，壞金沙灘內舍屋。
units.en: On guisi the Eastern Capital reported that the Lu River had overflowed and destroyed houses at Jinsha Beach.
units.literal: On the guisi day, the Eastern Capital reported that the Lu River overflowed and destroyed houses within Jinsha Beach.

units.zh: 幽州趙思溫奏：「瀛、莫兩州，元系當道，其刺史常行周、白彥球乞發遣至臣本府。」
units.en: Zhao Siwen of Youzhou memorialized: "The two prefectures of Ying and Mo originally belonged to this circuit; their prefects Chang Xingchou and Bai Yanqiu request to be sent to my headquarters."
units.literal: Zhao Siwen of Youzhou memorialized: "The two prefectures of Ying and Mo originally belonged to this circuit; their prefects Chang Xingchou and Bai Yanqiu request to be sent to my headquarters."

units.zh: 詔遣行周等赴闕。
units.en: An edict ordered Chang Xingchou and the others to proceed to the capital.
units.literal: An edict ordered Chang Xingchou and the others to proceed to the capital.

units.zh: 甲午，六宅使張言自魏府回，奏範延光叛命。
units.en: On jiawu, Palace Attendant Zhang Yan returned from Weifu and reported that Fan Yanguang had rebelled.
units.literal: On the jiawu day, Palace Attendant Zhang Yan returned from Weifu and reported that Fan Yanguang had rebelled.

units.zh: 滑州符彥饒飛奏，有兵士自北來，傳範延光到黎陽，乞發兵屯禦。
units.en: Fu Yanrao of Huazhou sent an urgent report that soldiers from the north reported Fan Yanguang at Liyang and pleaded for troops to garrison the area.
units.literal: Fu Yanrao of Huazhou sent an urgent report stating that soldiers had come from the north reporting that Fan Yanguang had reached Liyang, and requesting that troops be sent to garrison in defense.

units.zh: 宣遣客省使李守貞往延光所問罪。
units.en: The court announced that Reception Commissioner Li Shouzhen would be sent to Fan Yanguang's camp to call him to account.
units.literal: It was announced that Reception Commissioner Li Shouzhen would be sent to Fan Yanguang's location to question him on his offense.

units.zh: 尋命護聖都指揮使白奉進領騎士一千五百赴白馬渡巡檢。
units.en: Shortly afterward, Imperial Guard Commander Bai Fengjin was ordered to lead fifteen hundred cavalry to Baima Ford to patrol and inspect.
units.literal: Soon afterward, Imperial Guard Commander Bai Fengjin was ordered to lead fifteen hundred cavalry to Baima Ford for patrol and inspection.

units.zh: 乙未，魏府範延光男閑廄使守圖送御史臺。
units.en: On yiwei, Fan Yanguang's son Shoutu, Imperial Stud Attendant, was delivered to the Censorate.
units.literal: On the yiwei day, Fan Yanguang's son, Imperial Stud Attendant Shoutu, was sent to the Censorate.

units.zh: 攝荊南節度行軍司馬、檢校太保、歸州刺史王保義加檢校太傅，知武泰軍節度觀察留後，充荊南行軍司馬兼沿淮巡檢使。
units.en: Wang Baoyi, acting campaign adjutant of Jingnan, Acting Grand Protector, and Prefect of Guizhou, was further made Acting Grand Preceptor, left in charge of Wutai as observation commissioner, and charged with Jingnan campaigning duties and patrol along the Huai.
units.literal: Wang Baoyi, acting campaign adjutant of Jingnan, Acting Grand Protector, and Prefect of Guizhou, was further granted Acting Grand Preceptor, made acting military governor and observer of Wutai, and appointed campaign adjutant of Jingnan and commissioner for patrol along the Huai River.

units.zh: 襄州奏，江水漲一丈二尺。
units.en: Xiangzhou reported the Yangtze had risen twelve feet.
units.literal: Xiangzhou reported that the Yangtze River had risen twelve feet.

units.zh: 丁酉，遣內班史進能押信箭一對，往滑州賜符彥饒。
units.en: On dingyou, inner attendant Shi Jinneng was dispatched to Huazhou with a pair of trust arrows for Fu Yanrao.
units.literal: On the dingyou day, inner attendant Shi Jinneng was sent bearing a pair of trust arrows to Huazhou to bestow them on Fu Yanrao.

units.zh: 以前磁州刺史劉審交為魏府計度使，以東都巡檢使張從賓充魏府四南面都部署；
units.en: Liu Shenjiao, former Prefect of Cizhou, became supply commissioner for Weifu; Zhang Congbin, Eastern Capital inspection commissioner, became overall commander of the four southern sectors of Weifu;
units.literal: Liu Shenjiao, former Prefect of Cizhou, was made supply commissioner for Weifu; Zhang Congbin, Eastern Capital inspection commissioner, was made overall commander of the four southern sectors of Weifu;

units.zh: 遣侍衛使楊光遠領步騎一萬赴滑州。
units.en: Palace Guard Commissioner Yang Guangyuan was dispatched leading ten thousand infantry and cavalry to Huazhou.
units.literal: Palace Guard Commissioner Yang Guangyuan was sent leading ten thousand infantry and cavalry to Huazhou.

units.zh: 以東都副留守張延播充洛京都巡檢使。
units.en: Zhang Yanbo, deputy defender of the Eastern Capital, became capital patrol commissioner for Luoyang.
units.literal: Zhang Yanbo, deputy defender of the Eastern Capital, was made capital patrol commissioner for Luoyang.

units.zh: 白奉進奏：「捉得賊卒張柔，稱範延光差澶州刺史馮暉充一行都部署，元從都押衙孫銳充一行兵馬都監。」
units.en: Bai Fengjin reported: "We captured the rebel soldier Zhang Rou, who said that Fan Yanguang had dispatched Cangzhou Prefect Feng Hui to serve as overall commander of the expedition, and Sun Rui, formerly chief military adjutant of his personal following, to serve as overall military inspector of the expedition."
units.literal: Bai Fengjin reported: "We captured the rebel soldier Zhang Rou, who said that Fan Yanguang had dispatched Cangzhou Prefect Feng Hui to serve as overall commander of the expedition, and Sun Rui, formerly chief military adjutant of his personal following, to serve as overall military inspector of the expedition."

units.zh: 帝覽奏，謂侍臣曰：「朕雖寡德寡謀，自謂不居延光之下，而馮暉、孫銳過於兒戲，朝夕就擒，安能抗拒大軍為我之患乎！」
units.en: Reading the dispatch, the emperor told his ministers: "I may lack wisdom and virtue, but I do not rank myself below Yanguang. Feng Hui and Sun Rui treat war as child's play—they will be taken within days. What threat can such men pose to my armies?"
units.literal: The emperor read the report and said to the attending ministers: "Although I am lacking in virtue and counsel, I still do not consider myself beneath Yanguang; yet Feng Hui and Sun Rui treat war like child's play—they will be seized within days. How could they resist the great army and become a trouble to me!

units.zh: 天平軍節度使安審琦起復舊任，翰林學士、禮部侍郎和凝改端明殿學士。
units.en: An Shenqi, Military Commissioner of Tianping, was recalled to his former post; He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Rites, became Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination.
units.literal: An Shenqi, Military Commissioner of Tianping, was recalled to his former post; He Ning, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Rites, was made Academician of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination.

units.zh: 乙巳，範延光差牙將王知新賫表到闕，不令朝見，收付武德司。
units.en: On yisi, Fan Yanguang's adjutant Wang Zhixin arrived at court with a memorial; denied audience, he was handed over to the Bureau of Martial Virtue.
units.literal: On the yisi day, Fan Yanguang's adjutant Wang Zhixin, bearing a memorial, arrived at court; he was not granted an audience and was taken into custody by the Bureau of Martial Virtue.

units.zh: 丁未，詔侍衛使楊光遠充魏府四面都部署；
units.en: On dingwei, Palace Guard Commissioner Yang Guangyuan was made overall commander on all four sides of Weifu;
units.literal: On the dingwei day, an edict appointed Palace Guard Commissioner Yang Guangyuan overall commander on all four sides of Weifu;

units.zh: 以張從賓充副，兼諸軍都虞候；
units.en: Zhang Congbin was named his deputy and chief disciplinarian for all armies;
units.literal: Zhang Congbin was made his deputy, concurrently serving as overall military disciplinarian for all armies;

units.zh: 昭義節度使高行周充魏府西面都部署。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, was assigned the western front at Weifu.
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, was made western sector commander for Weifu.

units.zh: 是日，張從賓亦叛，與範延光葉謀，害皇子河陽節度使重信、皇子東都留守重乂。
units.en: That same day Zhang Congbin rebelled too; in league with Fan Yanguang he murdered Prince Chongxin, Military Commissioner of Heyang, and Prince Chongyi, defender of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: That same day, Zhang Congbin also rebelled; conspiring with Fan Yanguang, he killed Imperial Prince Chongxin, Military Commissioner of Heyang, and Imperial Prince Chongyi, defender of the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 己酉，以奉國都指揮使侯益、護聖都指揮使杜重威領步騎五千往屯汜水關，備從賓之亂也。
units.en: On jiyou, Hou Yi of the Fengguo Guard and Du Chongwei of the Imperial Guard were sent with five thousand troops to hold Sishui Pass against Zhang Congbin.
units.literal: On the jiyou day, Hou Yi, Commander of the Fengguo Guard, and Du Chongwei, Commander of the Imperial Guard, were ordered to lead five thousand infantry and cavalry to garrison Sishui Pass against Zhang Congbin's rebellion.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：七月，張從賓攻汜水關，殺巡檢使宋廷浩。
units.en: (The Comprehensive Mirror records: In the seventh month, Zhang Congbin assaulted Sishui Pass and killed patrol commissioner Song Tinghao.
units.literal: (The Comprehensive Mirror records: In the seventh month, Zhang Congbin attacked Sishui Pass and killed patrol commissioner Song Tinghao.

units.zh: 帝戎服，嚴整輕騎，將奔晉陽以避之，桑維翰叩頭苦諫曰：「賊鋒雖盛，勢不能久，請少待之，不可輕動。」
units.en: The emperor donned martial garb, arrayed light cavalry in tight order, and was about to flee to Jinyang to avoid the rebels. Sang Weihan kowtowed and remonstrated bitterly, saying: "Though the rebels' edge is keen, their force cannot long endure—please wait a little; you must not move lightly."
units.literal: The emperor donned martial garb, arrayed light cavalry in tight order, and was about to flee to Jinyang to avoid the rebels. Sang Weihan kowtowed and remonstrated bitterly, saying: "Though the rebels' edge is keen, their force cannot long endure—please wait a little; you must not move lightly."

units.zh: 帝乃止。）〉
units.en: The emperor stayed.)〉
units.literal: The emperor then stopped.)〉

units.zh: 七月辛亥，兩浙錢元瓘奏：「弟吳越士客馬步諸軍都指揮使、靜海軍節度使元球，非時入府，欲謀為亂，腰下搜得匕首，已誅戮訖。」
units.en: On the xinhai day of the seventh month, Qian Yuanguan of the Two Zhes memorialized: "My younger brother Yuanqiu, commander of Wu-Yue's land and sea forces and Military Commissioner of Jinghai, entered the prefectural seat at an improper time intending to plot rebellion; a dagger was found at his waist, and he has already been executed."
units.literal: On the xinhai day of the seventh month, Qian Yuanguan of the Two Zhes memorialized: "My younger brother Yuanqiu, commander of Wu-Yue's land and sea forces and Military Commissioner of Jinghai, entered the prefectural seat at an improper time intending to plot rebellion; a dagger was found at his waist, and he has already been executed."

units.zh: 詔削元球在身官爵。
units.en: An edict stripped Yuanqiu of every rank and title he had held.
units.literal: An edict stripped Yuanqiu of all titles and offices he held in life.

units.zh: 甲寅，奉國都指揮使馬萬奏，滑州節度使符彥饒作亂，屠害侍衛馬軍都指揮使白奉進，尋以所部兵擒到彥饒，差立功都虞候方太押送赴闕。
units.en: On jiayin, Ma Wan of the Fengguo Guard reported that Fu Yanrao of Huazhou had rebelled and killed Bai Fengjin, commander of the palace cavalry guard; Yanrao's own troops soon seized him, and Chief of Staff Fang Tai escorted him to court.
units.literal: On the jiayin day, Ma Wan, Commander of the Fengguo Guard, reported that Fu Yanrao, Military Commissioner of Huazhou, had rebelled and slaughtered Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry Bai Fengjin; shortly afterward his own troops captured Yanrao, and Chief of Staff Fang Tai was dispatched to escort him to court.

units.zh: 尋賜死於路。
units.en: He was executed en route.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was granted death on the road.

units.zh: 是日，削奪範延光在身官爵。
units.en: That same day Fan Yanguang was stripped of every rank and title.
units.literal: That same day, Fan Yanguang was stripped of all titles and offices he held in life.

units.zh: 以馬萬為滑州節度使；
units.en: Ma Wan became Military Commissioner of Huazhou;
units.literal: Ma Wan was made Military Commissioner of Huazhou;

units.zh: 以昭義節度使高行周為河南尹、東都留守，充西面行營諸軍都部署；
units.en: Gao Xingzhou, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, became Intendant of Henan and Eastern Capital Regent, overall commander of the western campaign;
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, was made Intendant of Henan and Eastern Capital Regent, overall commander of the western campaigning armies;

units.zh: 以護聖左右廂都指揮使杜重威為昭義軍節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使，充西面行營副部署；
units.en: Du Chongwei, commander of the Imperial Guard wings, became Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi and commander of the palace cavalry guard, deputy commander of the western campaign;
units.literal: Du Chongwei, commander of the left and right wings of the Imperial Guard, was made Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi and Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry, deputy commander of the western campaign;

units.zh: 以奉國都指揮使侯益為河陽節度使；
units.en: Hou Yi of the Fengguo Guard became Military Commissioner of Heyang;
units.literal: Hou Yi, Commander of the Fengguo Guard, was made Military Commissioner of Heyang;

units.zh: 以右神武統軍王周充魏府行營步軍都指揮使；
units.en: Wang Zhou, commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, became infantry commander of the Weifu campaign;
units.literal: Wang Zhou, Commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, was made infantry commander of the Weifu campaign;

units.zh: 以滑州節度使馬萬充魏府行營馬軍都指揮使；
units.en: Ma Wan, Military Commissioner of Huazhou, became cavalry commander of the Weifu campaign;
units.literal: Ma Wan, Military Commissioner of Huazhou, was made cavalry commander of the Weifu campaign;

units.zh: 以左僕射劉句充東都留守，兼判河南府事。
units.en: Liu Ju, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, became Eastern Capital Regent with charge of Henan Prefecture.
units.literal: Liu Ju, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Eastern Capital Regent with concurrent authority over Henan Prefecture.

units.zh: 杜重威等奏：「收下汜水關，破賊千人。
units.en: Du Chongwei and others reported: "Sishui Pass is ours; a thousand rebels were broken.
units.literal: Du Chongwei and others reported: "We took Sishui Pass and broke a thousand rebels.

units.zh: 張從賓及其殘黨奔投入河。
units.en: Zhang Congbin and his surviving followers drowned themselves in the river.
units.literal: Zhang Congbin and his remnant band threw themselves into the river.

units.zh: 兼收到護聖指揮使曹再晟一百人騎，稱背賊投來，並送赴行闕。」
units.en: We also received one hundred horsemen of Imperial Guard Commander Cao Zaizheng, who said they had deserted the rebels and come over; all were sent to the campaigning court."
units.literal: We also received one hundred horsemen of Imperial Guard Commander Cao Zaizheng, who said they had deserted the rebels and come over; all were sent to the campaigning court."

units.zh: 升貝州為防禦使額。
units.en: Beizhou was raised to defensive-commissioner status.
units.literal: Beizhou was promoted to the quota of a defensive commissioner.

units.zh: 皇子故東都留守重乂贈太傅，皇子故河陽節度使重信贈太尉。
units.en: Prince Chongyi, slain Eastern Capital regent, was posthumously made Grand Preceptor; Prince Chongxin, slain Military Commissioner of Heyang, Grand Preceptor of the State.
units.literal: The late Imperial Prince and former Eastern Capital Regent Chongyi was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor; the late Imperial Prince and former Military Commissioner of Heyang Chongxin was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor of the State.

units.zh: 敕：「朋助張從賓、逆人張延播、張繼祚等十人，宜令收捕，親的骨肉並處斬。」
units.en: An edict: "Those who befriended and aided Zhang Congbin—the traitors Zhang Yanbo, Zhang Jizuo, and ten others—shall be seized; their close kin shall all be executed."
units.literal: An edict: "Those who befriended and aided Zhang Congbin—the traitors Zhang Yanbo, Zhang Jizuo, and ten others—shall be seized; their close kin shall all be executed."

units.zh: 丁卯，以唐開府儀同三司、守太尉、兼中書令、西平王李晟五代孫戢為耀州司戶參軍，示勸忠之義也。
units.en: On dingmao, Li Zhan, fifth-generation descendant of Tang hero Li Sheng, was appointed registrar of Yaozhou—a gesture honoring loyal service across generations.
units.literal: On the dingmao day, Li Zhan, fifth-generation descendant of Tang's Li Sheng, Kaifu yitong sansi, Grand Preceptor, concurrent Palace Secretariat Director, and Prince of Xiping, was made Registrar of Yaozhou—showing the principle of encouraging loyalty.

units.zh: 壬申，帝御崇元殿，備禮冊四廟，親授寶冊於使攝太尉、守司空、門下侍郎、平章事馮道，使副攝司徒、守工部尚書裴皞，赴洛京行禮。
units.en: On renshen the emperor presided at the Chongyuan Hall in full state to invest the four ancestral shrines, entrusting the sacred registers to Feng Dao, acting grand marshal and chief councilor, while Pei Hao, acting minister of works and education, went to Luoyang as deputy to perform the rites.
units.literal: On the renshen day, the emperor attended the Chongyuan Hall in full ceremonial array to invest the four temples, personally handing the precious registers to envoy acting as Grand Marshal Feng Dao, acting Sikong, Vice Minister of State Affairs and Grand Councilor, while deputy envoy Pei Hao, acting Minister of Education and acting Minister of Works, proceeded to Luoyang to perform the rites.

units.zh: 甲戌，以宰臣趙瑩判戶部，以吏部侍郎判戶部龍敏為東都副留守。
units.en: On jiaxu, Chief Minister Zhao Ying was given charge of the Ministry of Revenue; Long Min, Vice Minister of Personnel overseeing revenue, became Eastern Capital Deputy Regent.
units.literal: On the jiaxu day, Chief Minister Zhao Ying was given charge of the Ministry of Revenue; Long Min, Vice Minister of Personnel with charge of revenue, was made Eastern Capital Deputy Regent.

units.zh: 詔洛京留司百官並赴闕。
units.en: An edict summoned every official of the Luoyang resident administration to the capital.
units.literal: An edict ordered all officials of the Luoyang resident administration to come to court.

units.zh: 安州軍亂，指揮使王暉害節度使周瑰於理所。
units.en: Anzhou erupted in mutiny; Commander Wang Hui murdered Military Commissioner Zhou Gui in the prefectural hall.
units.literal: Anzhou mutinied; Commander Wang Hui killed Military Commissioner Zhou Gui in the administrative hall.

units.zh: 遣右衛上將軍李金全領千騎赴安州。
units.en: Li Jinquan, Senior General of the Right Guard, was sent to Anzhou with a thousand cavalry.
units.literal: Li Jinquan, Senior General of the Right Guard, was dispatched to lead a thousand horsemen to Anzhou.

units.zh: 八月辛巳，以許州節度使萇從簡為徐州節度使，以陜州節度使、侍衛馬步軍都虞候劉知遠為許州節度使，以權北京留守、徐州節度使安彥威為太原尹、北京留守、河東節度使。
units.en: On xinsi in the eighth month, Chang Congjian of Xu became Military Commissioner of Xuzhou; Liu Zhiyuan of Shan, chief adjutant of the palace guard, became Military Commissioner of Xu; and An Yanwei, acting Northern Capital regent and Military Commissioner of Xu, became Prefect of Taiyuan, Northern Capital regent, and Military Commissioner of Hedong.
units.literal: On the xinsi day of the eighth month, Chang Congjian, Military Commissioner of Xuzhou, was made Military Commissioner of Xuzhou; Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of Shanzhou and Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard, was made Military Commissioner of Xuzhou; An Yanwei, acting Northern Capital Regent and Military Commissioner of Xuzhou, was made Prefect of Taiyuan, Northern Capital Regent, and Military Commissioner of Hedong.

units.zh: 宰臣監修國史趙瑩奏：「請循近例，依唐明宗朝，凡有內廷公事及言動之間，委端明殿學士或樞密院學士侍立冕旒，系日編錄，逐季送當館。
units.en: Chief Minister and supervisor of the national history Zhao Ying memorialized: "We ask to follow recent precedent according to the reign of Tang Emperor Mingzong: whenever there are inner-court affairs and utterances, let an academician of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination or the Bureau of Military Affairs attend beside the throne, record by day, and each quarter send materials to the historiographical office.
units.literal: Chief Minister and supervisor of the national history Zhao Ying memorialized: "We ask to follow recent precedent according to the reign of Tang Emperor Mingzong: whenever there are inner-court affairs and utterances, let an academician of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination or the Bureau of Military Affairs attend beside the throne, record by day, and each quarter send materials to the historiographical office.

units.zh: 其百司公事，亦望逐季送當館，旋要編修日曆。」
units.en: For the hundred offices' official business as well, we hope each quarter to send materials to the office, to be compiled when the calendar is revised."
units.literal: For the hundred offices' official business as well, we hope each quarter to send materials to the office, to be compiled when the calendar is revised."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: It was approved.

units.zh: 丁亥，以前宋州節度使李從敏為陜州節度使。
units.en: On dinghai, Li Congmin, former Military Commissioner of Songzhou, became Military Commissioner of Shanzhou.
units.literal: On the dinghai day, Li Congmin, former Military Commissioner of Songzhou, was made Military Commissioner of Shanzhou.

units.zh: 戊子，以尚書左丞鄭韜光為戶部尚書致仕。
units.en: On wuzi, Zheng Taoguang, Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, retired as Minister of Revenue.
units.literal: On the wuzi day, Zheng Taoguang, Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works, retired as Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 改元德殿為廣政殿，門名從之。
units.en: The Hall of Primordial Virtue was renamed the Hall of Broad Governance, and its gates were renamed accordingly.
units.literal: The Hall of Primordial Virtue was renamed the Hall of Broad Governance, and the gate names followed suit.

units.zh: 庚子，華州奏渭河泛溢，害稼。
units.en: On gengzi, Huazhou reported the Wei River in flood and crops ruined.
units.literal: On the gengzi day, Huazhou reported that the Wei River had overflowed and damaged the crops.

units.zh: 宰臣馮道加開府儀同三司、食邑實封；
units.en: Chief Minister Feng Dao was granted Kaifu yitong sansi with substantive fief income;
units.literal: Chief Minister Feng Dao was granted Kaifu yitong sansi and substantive fief income;

units.zh: 左僕射劉句加特進，兼鹽鐵轉運等使。
units.en: Liu Ju, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, received extraordinary promotion and charge of the salt, iron, and transport offices.
units.literal: Liu Ju, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was granted extraordinary promotion and concurrent charge of the salt, iron, and transport offices.

units.zh: 故東京留守判官李遐可贈右諫議大夫，其母田氏封京兆郡太君，子孫量才敘錄，仍加賻贈，長給遐在身祿俸，終母之世。
units.en: Li Xia, slain judge to the Eastern Capital regent, was posthumously made Right Remonstrance Censor; his mother Lady Tian was enfeoffed Lady of Jingzhao; his descendants were to receive appointments as merit allowed; funeral gifts were added; and his salary was continued to his mother for life.
units.literal: The late judge to the Eastern Capital regent Li Xia was posthumously granted Right Remonstrance Censor; his mother Lady Tian was enfeoffed Lady of Jingzhao Commandery; his descendants were to be placed according to talent; additional funeral gifts were added; and Xia's salary in life was to be paid for life to his mother.

units.zh: 先是，遐監左藏庫於洛陽，會張從賓叛，令強取錢帛，遐拒而不與，因而遇害，故有是命。
units.en: Xia had overseen the Luoyang treasury when Zhang Congbin rebelled and demanded its funds; Xia refused and was killed—hence this decree of remembrance.
units.literal: Earlier, Xia had supervised the left treasury at Luoyang; when Zhang Congbin rebelled, Congbin forcibly demanded money and silk, and Xia refused to give them—whereupon he was killed; hence this order.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔：「天下見禁囚徒，除十惡五逆、放火劫舍、持杖殺人、合造毒藥、官典犯贓、欠負官錢外，其餘不問輕重、已發覺未發覺、已結正未結正，並從釋放。
units.en: On the yisi day, an edict: "All prisoners under detention in the realm, apart from the ten abominations and five rebellions, arson and robbery of dwellings, murder with a staff, compounding poison, official clerks guilty of embezzlement, and owing official money, regardless of severity, whether discovered or not, whether case closed or not—all are released.
units.literal: On the yisi day, an edict: "All prisoners under detention in the realm, apart from the ten abominations and five rebellions, arson and robbery of dwellings, murder with a staff, compounding poison, official clerks guilty of embezzlement, and owing official money, regardless of severity, whether discovered or not, whether case closed or not—all are released.

units.zh: 應自張從賓作亂以來，有曾被張從賓及張延播脅從染汙者，及符彥饒下隨身軍將等，兼安州王暉徒黨，除已誅戮外，並從釋放，一切不問。
units.en: All who since Zhang Congbin's rebellion were forced into his service, Zhang Yanbo's band, Fu Yanrao's guard, or Wang Hui of Anzhou—save those executed—were pardoned without question.
units.literal: From the time of Zhang Congbin's rebellion, those coerced or stained by Zhang Congbin and Zhang Yanbo, the personal guard officers under Fu Yanrao, and the followers of Wang Hui of Anzhou, apart from those already executed—all are released, with no inquiry whatsoever.

units.zh: 張繼祚在喪紀之中，承逆豎之意，顯從叛亂，難貸刑章。
units.en: Zhang Jizuo, still in mourning, willingly served the rebel cause and took up arms—the law could not spare him.
units.literal: Zhang Jizuo, in the period of mourning, accepted the rebel chieftain's intent and openly joined the rebellion—the penal code cannot spare him.

units.zh: 乃眷先臣，實有遺德，遽茲乏祀，深所軫懷。
units.en: Yet his ancestor had served with honor, and to see that house left without rites grieved the court deeply.
units.literal: Yet in regard to his forebear, there was indeed residual virtue; suddenly to leave his line without sacrifice deeply wounds the heart.

units.zh: 其一房家業，準法雖已藉沒，所有先臣並祖父母墳莊祠堂，並可交付骨肉主張。
units.en: Though that branch's property was forfeit by law, its ancestral graves, estates, and shrines might be restored to the family to maintain.
units.literal: The estates of that branch of the family, though by law already confiscated—all ancestral graves, manor lands, and shrines of the forebear and grandparents may be delivered to flesh-and-blood kin to hold in trust.

units.zh: 應自梁朝、後唐以來，前後奉使及北京沿邊管界擄掠往向北人口，宜令官給錢物，差使賫持，往彼收贖，放歸本家」云。
units.en: Further: for people seized on the northern frontier since the Liang and Later Tang and carried into captivity, the state would provide funds and send envoys to ransom them and restore them to their homes."
units.literal: From the Liang and Later Tang down to the present, for envoys sent on mission and populations seized along the Northern Capital frontier and carried north—official funds and goods should be provided, and envoys dispatched bearing them to redeem those persons and return them to their native households."

units.zh: 繼祚，故齊王全義之子也，故有是詔。
units.en: Jizuo was son of the late Prince of Qi, Zhang Quanyi—hence this mixed decree of punishment and mercy.
units.literal: Jizuo was the son of the late Prince of Qi, Zhang Quanyi—hence this edict.

units.zh: 丙午，詔：「天下刑獄系囚染疾者，宜差醫工治療，官中量給藥價。
units.en: On the bingwu day, an edict: "Prisoners in penal detention throughout the realm who have contracted illness shall be treated by assigned physicians, with medicine costs measured and supplied by the state.
units.literal: On the bingwu day, an edict: "Prisoners in penal detention throughout the realm who have contracted illness shall be treated by assigned physicians, with medicine costs measured and supplied by the state.

units.zh: 事輕者仍許家人看候，合杖者俟損日決遣。」
units.en: In minor cases families might attend them; those awaiting beating would be sentenced only after their injuries had mended."
units.literal: In lighter cases, family may still attend them; those due flogging shall be sentenced and dispatched once their wounds have healed."

units.zh: 九月庚戌朔，以前太府卿兼通事舍人陳瓚為衛尉卿兼通事舍人。
units.en: On the first day of the ninth month, Chen Zan, former Minister of the Imperial Treasury and Master of Diplomatic Reception, became Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud with concurrent Master of Diplomatic Reception.
units.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, gengxu, Chen Zan, former Minister of the Imperial Treasury with concurrent Master of Diplomatic Reception, was made Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud with concurrent Master of Diplomatic Reception.

units.zh: 壬子，故安遠軍節度使周瑰贈太傅。
units.en: On renzi, Zhou Gui, former Military Commissioner of Anyuan, was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: On the renzi day, Zhou Gui, former Military Commissioner of Anyuan Army, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 甲寅，皇子北京留守、知河東軍府事、太原尹重貴加檢校太保，為右金吾衛上將軍。
units.en: On jiayin, Imperial Prince Chonggui, Northern Capital regent, overseer of Hedong, and Prefect of Taiyuan, became Acting Grand Guardian and Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard.
units.literal: On the jiayin day, Imperial Prince Chonggui, Northern Capital Regent, overseer of Hedong military prefecture, and Prefect of Taiyuan, was made Acting Grand Guardian and Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard.

units.zh: 以右龍武統軍安崇阮為右衛上將軍，以前保大軍節度使、檢校太尉張萬進為右龍衛軍統軍，以右領軍衛上將軍、權知安州軍州事李金全為安遠軍節度使。
units.en: An Chongruan, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, became Senior General of the Right Guard; Zhang Wanjin, former Military Commissioner of Baoda with Acting Grand Preceptor, became commander of the Right Dragon Guard Army; and Li Jinquan, Senior General of the Right Lead Army Guard acting at Anzhou, became Military Commissioner of Anyuan.
units.literal: An Chongruan, Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made Senior General of the Right Guard; Zhang Wanjin, former Military Commissioner of Baoda Army and Acting Grand Preceptor, was made Commander of the Right Dragon Guard Army; Li Jinquan, Senior General of the Right Lead Army Guard and acting in charge of Anzhou military and prefectural affairs, was made Military Commissioner of Anyuan Army.

units.zh: 魏府招討使楊光遠進攻城圖。
units.en: Yang Guangyuan, pacification commissioner at Weifu, submitted a plan for assaulting the city.
units.literal: Yang Guangyuan, pacification commissioner of Weifu, submitted a plan for assaulting the city.

units.zh: 戊午，以太子賓客孔昭序為工部尚書致仕。
units.en: On wuwu, Kong Zhaoxu, Guest of the Heir Apparent, retired as Minister of Works.
units.literal: On the wuwu day, Kong Zhaoxu, Guest of the Heir Apparent, retired as Minister of Works.

units.zh: 將作少監高鴻漸上言：「伏睹近年已來，士庶之家死喪之苦。
units.en: Gao Hongjian, Vice Director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction, submitted: "Your subject has observed that in recent years the suffering of scholar-commoner households at death and mourning has been severe.
units.literal: Gao Hongjian, Vice Director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction, submitted: "Your subject has observed that in recent years the suffering of scholar-commoner households at death and mourning has been severe.

units.zh: 當殯葬之日，被諸色音聲伎藝人等作樂攪擾，求覓錢物，請行止絕。」
units.en: On the day of encoffining and burial, performers of every sort of music and acrobatic arts make music and cause disturbance, seeking money and goods—this should be stopped."
units.literal: On the day of encoffining and burial, performers of every sort of music and acrobatic arts make music and cause disturbance, seeking money and goods—this should be stopped."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: [The request] was approved.

units.zh: 庚申，靜江軍節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事馬希杲加階爵及功臣名號，以前兵部侍郎楊凝式為檢校兵部尚書、太子賓客，故右金吾衛上將軍羅周敬贈太傅。
units.en: On gengshen, Ma Xigao of Jingjiang, Acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Councilor, received increased rank and a new honorific; Yang Ningshi, former Vice Minister of War, became Acting Minister of War and Guest of the Heir Apparent; and the late Luo Zhoujing was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: On the gengshen day, Ma Xigao, Military Commissioner of Jingjiang Army, Acting Grand Preceptor, and Associate Grand Councilor, received increased rank and honorific title of meritorious minister; Yang Ningshi, former Vice Minister of War, was made Acting Minister of War and Guest of the Heir Apparent; the late Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard Luo Zhoujing was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 乙丑，鄧州節度使李從璋卒，贈太師。
units.en: On yichou, Li Congzhang, Military Commissioner of Dengzhou, died and was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: On the yichou day, Li Congzhang, Military Commissioner of Dengzhou, died and was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 改興唐府為廣晉府，興唐縣為廣晉縣。
units.en: Xingtang Prefecture was renamed Guangjin Prefecture, and Xingtang County Guangjin County.
units.literal: Xingtang Prefecture was renamed Guangjin Prefecture, and Xingtang County was renamed Guangjin County.

units.zh: 癸酉，以左諫議大夫、判度支王松為尚書工部侍郎。
units.en: On guiyou, Wang Song, Left Remonstrance Censor with charge of the Bureau of Budget, became Vice Minister of Works.
units.literal: On the guiyou day, Wang Song, Left Remonstrance Censor with charge of the Bureau of Budget, was made Vice Minister of Works.

units.zh: 甲戌，貝、衛兩州奏，河溢害稼。
units.en: On jiaxu, Bei and Wei prefectures reported the Yellow River in flood and crops damaged.
units.literal: On the jiaxu day, Bei and Wei prefectures reported that the Yellow River had overflowed and damaged crops.

units.zh: 乙亥，以將作監王丕為太子賓客。
units.en: On yihai, Wang Pi, Director of Imperial Construction, became Guest of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: On the yihai day, Wang Pi, Director of Imperial Construction, was made Guest of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 十月壬午，以宣徽南院使、左監門衛上將軍楊彥詢為鄧州威勝軍節度使。
units.en: On renwu in the tenth month, Yang Yanxun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Attendant Office and Senior General of the Left Gate Guard, became Military Commissioner of Weisheng at Dengzhou.
units.literal: On the renwu day of the tenth month, Yang Yanxun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Attendant Office and Senior General of the Left Gate Guard, was made Military Commissioner of Weisheng Army at Dengzhou.

units.zh: 詔選人試判兩道。
units.en: An edict ordered examination candidates tested on judgments in two fields.
units.literal: An edict ordered candidates to be examined on judgments in two fields.

units.zh: 以左司郎中張彖為右諫議大夫；
units.en: Zhang Yan, Bureau Director in the Left Secretariat, became Right Remonstrance Censor;
units.literal: Zhang Yan, Bureau Director in the Left Secretariat, was made Right Remonstrance Censor;

units.zh: 以刑部侍郎、鹽鐵轉運副使史圭為吏部侍郎；
units.en: Shi Gui, Vice Minister of Justice and Deputy Commissioner of Salt, Iron, and Transport, became Vice Minister of Personnel;
units.literal: Shi Gui, Vice Minister of Justice and Deputy Commissioner of Salt, Iron, and Transport, was made Vice Minister of Personnel;

units.zh: 以曹州刺史宋光業為宣徽北院使；
units.en: Song Guangye, Prefect of Caozhou, became Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Attendant Office;
units.literal: Song Guangye, Prefect of Caozhou, was made Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Attendant Office;

units.zh: 以左金吾衛大將軍高漢筠為左驍衛大將軍，充內客省使；
units.en: Gao Hanyun, Grand General of the Left Golden Crow Guard, became Grand General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard and Commissioner of the Inner Guest Office;
units.literal: Gao Hanyun, Grand General of the Left Golden Crow Guard, was made Grand General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard and Commissioner of the Inner Guest Office;

units.zh: 以宣徽北院使、左驍衛大將軍劉處讓為左監門衛上將軍，充宣徽南院使。
units.en: Liu Churang, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau and Grand General of the Left Valiant Cavalry, became Senior General of the Left Gate Guard and Commissioner of the Southern Bureau.
units.literal: Liu Churang, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Attendant Office and Grand General of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard, was made Senior General of the Left Gate Guard and Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Attendant Office.

units.zh: 丙戌，遣使祀五嶽四瀆。
units.en: On bingxu envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers.
units.literal: On the bingxu day, envoys were dispatched to offer sacrifices at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers.

units.zh: 故天平軍節度使閻寶追封太原郡王，故大同軍節度使李存璋贈太師，故瀛州刺史李嗣頵贈太尉，故相州刺史史建瑭、故代州刺史王建及並贈太保，故幽州節度使周德威追封燕王。
units.en: Yan Bao, former Military Commissioner of Tianping, was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Taiyuan; Li Cunzhang of Datong was posthumously made Grand Preceptor; Li Siyin of Yingzhou Grand Preceptor of the State; Shi Jiantang of Xiangzhou and Wang Jianji of Daizhou both Grand Guardian; and Zhou Dewei of Youzhou posthumously Prince of Yan.
units.literal: Yan Bao, former Military Commissioner of Tianping Army, was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Taiyuan; Li Cunzhang of Datong Army was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor; Li Siyin, former Prefect of Yingzhou, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor of the State; Shi Jianya, former Prefect of Xiangzhou, and Wang Jian of Daizhou were both posthumously granted Grand Guardian; Zhou Dewei, former Military Commissioner of Youzhou, was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Yan.

units.zh: 十一月庚戌，賜楊光遠空名官告，自司空至常侍凡四十道，將士立功者，得補之而後奏。
units.en: On gengxu in the eleventh month, Yang Guangyuan received forty blank commissions from Sikong through Regular Attendant, so meritorious soldiers could be appointed first and reported afterward.
units.literal: On the gengxu day of the eleventh month, Yang Guangyuan was granted blank commission documents from Sikong through Regular Attendant—forty in all—so that soldiers who achieved merit might be appointed first and then reported.

units.zh: 中書上言：「準唐貞元二年九月五日敕，文官充翰林學士及皇太子諸王侍讀，武官充禁軍職事，並不常朝參。
units.en: The Chancellery submitted: "According to the Tang edict of the fifth day of the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan, civil officials serving as Hanlin academicians and tutors to the crown prince and imperial princes, and military officials serving in palace guard duties, do not attend regular court audience.
units.literal: The Chancellery submitted: "According to the Tang edict of the fifth day of the ninth month of the second year of Zhenyuan, civil officials serving as Hanlin academicians and tutors to the crown prince and imperial princes, and military officials serving in palace guard duties, do not attend regular court audience.

units.zh: 其在三館等諸職事者，並朝參訖各歸所務。
units.en: Those in the Three Institutes and similar posts attended audience and then returned to their duties.
units.literal: Those in posts at the Three Institutes and other offices, after attending audience, each return to their duties.

units.zh: 自累朝以來，文武在內廷充職兼判三司，或帶職額及六軍判官等，例不赴常朝，元無正敕。
units.en: Since successive dynasties, inner-court officials with concurrent Three Agencies duties or six-army judge titles had by precedent skipped regular audience without a formal edict.
units.literal: Since successive dynasties, civil and military officials serving in the inner court with concurrent charge of the Three Agencies, or bearing titles and six-army judge posts, have by precedent not attended regular audience, though there was originally no formal edict.

units.zh: 準近敕，文武職事官未升朝者，按舊制並赴朔望朝參。
units.en: Under the recent edict, officials not yet promoted to regular audience were to attend the first-and-fifteenth sessions per the old system.
units.literal: According to the recent edict, civil and military officials not yet promoted to court audience should, under the old system, attend the first-and-fifteenth audience.

units.zh: 其翰林學士、侍讀、三館職事，望準元敕處分。
units.en: Hanlin academicians, tutors, and Three Institutes posts were to follow the original edict.
units.literal: For Hanlin academicians, tutors, and Three Institutes posts, we hope the original edict may be applied.

units.zh: 其諸在內廷諸司使等，每受正官之時，來赴正衙，謝後不赴常朝，大朝會不離禁廷位次。
units.en: Inner-court commissioners, on receiving appointment, thanked at the main court and then skipped regular audience, remaining in palace order at great assemblies.
units.literal: For commissioners of the various inner-court offices, when they receive formal appointment they come to the main court to give thanks and then do not attend regular audience; at great assemblies they remain in palace guard order.

units.zh: 三司職官免常朝，唯赴大朝會。
units.en: Three Agencies officials were exempt from regular audience and attended only great assemblies.
units.literal: Three Agencies officials are exempt from regular audience and attend only great assemblies.

units.zh: 其京師未升朝官員，只赴朔望朝參，帶諸司職掌者不在此例。
units.en: Capital officials not yet in regular audience attended only first-and-fifteenth sessions, except those with concurrent agency duties.
units.literal: Officials in the capital not yet promoted to audience attend only the first-and-fifteenth sessions; those bearing concurrent agency duties are not within this rule.

units.zh: 文官除翰林端明殿翰林學士、樞密院學士、中書省知制誥外，有兼官兼職者，仍各發遣本司公事。」
units.en: Apart from Hanlin academicians of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination, military affairs academicians, and Chancellery rescript drafters, civil officials with concurrent posts still dispatch routine business to their home offices."
units.literal: Apart from Hanlin academicians of the Hall of Brilliant Illumination, military affairs academicians, and Chancellery rescript drafters, civil officials with concurrent posts still dispatch routine business to their home offices."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: [The memorial] was approved.

units.zh: 丙辰，太子賓客王丕卒。
units.en: On bingchen, Wang Pi, Guest of the Heir Apparent, died.
units.literal: On the bingchen day, Wang Pi, Guest of the Heir Apparent, died.

units.zh: 改洛京潛龍宅為廣德宮，北京潛龍宅為興義宮。
units.en: Luoyang's Hidden Dragon residence became the Palace of Broad Virtue; the Northern Capital's Hidden Dragon residence the Palace of Rising Righteousness.
units.literal: The Hidden Dragon residence in Luoyang was renamed the Palace of Broad Virtue; the Hidden Dragon residence in the Northern Capital was renamed the Palace of Rising Righteousness.

units.zh: 戊午，中書奏：「準雜令，車駕巡幸所祇承者，賜會並同京官。」
units.en: On the wuwu day, the Chancellery submitted: "According to miscellaneous regulations, those who attend the imperial carriage on tours receive banquet gifts equal to capital officials."
units.literal: On the wuwu day, the Chancellery submitted: "According to miscellaneous regulations, those who attend the imperial carriage on tours receive banquet gifts equal to capital officials."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: [The request] was approved.

units.zh: 戊辰，鎮海鎮東節度使、吳越王錢元瓘加天下兵馬副元帥，封吳越國王。
units.en: On wuchen, Qian Yuanguan, Military Commissioner of Zhenhai and Zhendong and King of Wuyue, became Deputy Commander-in-Chief of All Forces and was enfeoffed King of Wuyue.
units.literal: On the wuchen day, Qian Yuanguan, Military Commissioner of Zhenhai and Zhendong and King of Wuyue, was made Deputy Commander-in-Chief of All Forces Under Heaven and enfeoffed King of Wuyue.

units.zh: 庚午，以右拾遺李浣充翰林學士。
units.en: On gengwu, Li Huan, Right Remembrancer, was appointed Hanlin Academician.
units.literal: On the gengwu day, Li Huan, Right Remembrancer, was appointed Hanlin Academician.

units.zh: 甲戌，命太常卿程遜、兵部員外郎韋棁充吳越國王加恩使。
units.en: On jiaxu, Cheng Xun, Minister of Rites, and Wei Yun, Vice Director in the Ministry of War, were appointed envoys to confer favors on the King of Wuyue.
units.literal: On the jiaxu day, Cheng Xun, Minister of Rites, and Wei Yun, Vice Director in the Ministry of War, were appointed envoys to confer favors on the King of Wuyue.

units.zh: 丙子，以戶部侍郎張昭遠守本官，充翰林學士，仍知制誥。
units.en: On bingzi, Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Revenue, retained his post and became Hanlin Academician and rescript drafter.
units.literal: On the bingzi day, Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Revenue, retained his office and was appointed Hanlin Academician, still drafter of rescripts.

units.zh: 丁丑，湖南馬希範貢寶裝龍鳳器用、結銀花果子等物。
units.en: On dingchou, Ma Xifan of Hunan presented dragon-and-phoenix vessels with precious fittings, silver floral ornaments, and the like.
units.literal: On the dingchou day, Ma Xifan of Hunan presented tribute of dragon-and-phoenix vessels with precious fittings, silver floral fruit ornaments, and the like.

units.zh: 帝覽之，謂侍臣曰：「奇巧蕩心，斯何用耳！
units.en: The emperor viewed them and told his ministers, "Such curious craft unsettles the heart—what use is it?
units.literal: The emperor viewed them and said to his ministers: "Such curious craft unsettles the heart—what use is it!

units.zh: 但以來遠之道，不欲阻其意。」
units.en: Yet because this is the way of distant tribute, I do not wish to thwart their intent."
units.literal: Yet because this is the way of distant tribute, I do not wish to thwart their intent."

units.zh: 聞者服之。
units.en: Those who heard were impressed.
units.literal: Those who heard were impressed.

units.zh: 壬午，安州李金全上言：「奉詔抽臣元隨左都押衙胡漢筠，其人染重病，候損日赴闕。」
units.en: On the renwu day, Li Jinquan of Anzhou submitted: "In obedience to the edict summoning my former personal follower, Left Chief Military Adjutant Hu Hanyun, that man has contracted a serious illness and will come to court when he has recovered."
units.literal: On the renwu day, Li Jinquan of Anzhou submitted: "In obedience to the edict summoning my former personal follower, Left Chief Military Adjutant Hu Hanyun, that man has contracted a serious illness and will come to court when he has recovered."

units.zh: 漢筠本滑吏也，從金全歷數鎮，而濫聲喧聞。
units.en: Hanyun had been a clerk at Huazhou and followed Jinquan through several commands, yet his reputation spread without warrant.
units.literal: Hanyun had originally been a clerk at Huazhou and had followed Jinquan through several commands, yet his reputation spread far and wide without warrant.

units.zh: 帝知之，欲授以他職，免陷功臣。
units.en: The emperor knew this and wished to give him another post lest a meritorious minister be compromised.
units.literal: The emperor knew this and wished to give him another post, lest a meritorious minister be compromised.

units.zh: 漢筠懼其罪，遂托疾。
units.en: Hanyun feared punishment and feigned illness.
units.literal: Hanyun feared punishment and therefore feigned illness.

units.zh: 由是勸金全貳於朝廷，自此始也。
units.en: From this Jinquan was encouraged to turn against the court—the beginning of his defection.
units.literal: From this Jinquan was encouraged to turn against the court—this was the beginning of it.

units.zh: 十二月，以監察御史徐臺符為尚書膳部員外郎、知制誥，以右補闕史官修撰吳承範為尚書屯田員外郎、知制誥。
units.en: In the twelfth month, Xu Taifu, Investigating Censor, became Vice Director in the Ministry of Provisions with concurrent rescript drafting; Wu Chengfan, Right Supplementation Censor and historiographer, Vice Director in the Ministry of State Farms with concurrent rescript drafting.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Xu Taifu, Investigating Censor, was made Vice Director in the Ministry of Provisions with concurrent rescript drafting; Wu Chengfan, Right Supplementation Censor and historiographer, was made Vice Director in the Ministry of State Farms with concurrent rescript drafting.

units.zh: 左諫議大夫薛融改中書舍人，辭而不拜。
units.en: Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Censor, was offered Secretariat Drafter but declined.
units.literal: Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Censor, was transferred to Secretariat Drafter but declined and did not accept.

units.zh: 尚書水部郎中、知制誥王易簡改中書舍人，故隴西郡王李嗣昭追封韓王，故橫海軍節度使安審通贈太師。
units.en: Wang Yijian, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works and rescript drafter, became Secretariat Drafter; Li Sizhao, late Prince of Longxi, was posthumously Prince of Han; and An Shentong, former Military Commissioner of Henghai, posthumously Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: Wang Yijian, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Works and rescript drafter, was made Secretariat Drafter; Li Sizhao, late Prince of Longxi, was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Han; An Shentong, former Military Commissioner of Henghai, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 辛丑，湖南節度使、兼中書令、楚王馬希範加食邑實封，改賜扶天佐運同德致理功臣。
units.en: On xinchou, Ma Xifan of Hunan, Palace Secretariat Director and King of Chu, received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment and the honorific Upholding Heaven, Assisting Fortune, Shared Virtue, and Achieving Order.
units.literal: On the xinchou day, Ma Xifan, Military Commissioner of Hunan, concurrent Palace Secretariat Director, and King of Chu, received increased fief income and actual enfeoffment and was granted the honorific Upholding Heaven, Assisting Fortune, Shared Virtue, and Achieving Order.

units.zh: 甲辰，車駕幸相國寺祈雪。
units.en: On jiachen the emperor visited the Xiangguo Temple to pray for snow.
units.literal: On the jiachen day, the imperial carriage visited the Xiangguo Temple to pray for snow.
